<size=10> </size>

skills.descriptionTemplate:

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3</color>.
<size=10></size>

<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Aemeath</color></size>

Aemeath can switch forms between herself and her Mech. The Mech inherits Aemeath's Stats and unlocks new moves.
Aemeath automatically casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stage 1</color> upon casting <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color>.
While in the Mech form, Aemeath casts <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> automatically upon casting <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color> in mid-air.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2, 3 & 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color>, or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Aemeath</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Switch into the Mech form after casting this skill. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.

Can be cast in mid-air.
Switch into Aemeath after casting this skill. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Mech</color></size>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Mech</color></size>

Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button longer to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color>, dealing higher <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath: Charged II</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color>, or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> ends <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>.
This Skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged I</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech: Charged II</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Mech</color></size>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Mech</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

skills.name: Towards the Daybreak
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Overdrive</color></size>
Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Switch into Mech form after casting this skill.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Casting this skill grants the following effects:
- Enter <color=Highlight><te href=121002>Stardust Resonance</te></color> for {0}s.
- Enter <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> for {1}s.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to perform Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.
The next <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> cast within {2}s after casting this skill doesn't consume <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Stardust Resonance</color></size>
Enhance the effect of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color>.
This effect ends after <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> is cast {3} times.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Overdrive</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Finale</color>.
When in <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color> reaches the limit, enter <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>. <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> is removed when the <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict - Unbound</color> state ends.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavenfall Edict - Finale</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> when the following conditions are met:
- Be in the <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> state.
- <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> reaches the limit.
- <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color> reaches the limit.
Casting this skill depletes all <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, and ends the <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> state and <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> state.
Switch back to Aemeath after casting this skill.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.

skills.descriptionTemplate: In <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color> gain {0} DMG Amplification.

skills.descriptionTemplate:

DMG increases by {0}, up to {1} times. Each Resonator can only trigger this effect once.

With {6} stacks, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> DMG is Amplified by {7}.
Resonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.

skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Songs Across the Universe</color></size>
Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Cast this skill to enter <color=Highlight><te href=121006>Starlume Acceleration</te></color> for {0}s.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> and cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast  <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3</color> automatically.
<size=10></size>

In the Mech form, <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color>.

Casting this skill grants <color=Highlight><te href=121006>Starlume Acceleration</te></color> for {0}s.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> and cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Form Switch</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3</color> automatically.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Starlume Acceleration</color></size>
In <color=Highlight>Starlume Acceleration</color>, casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> addtionally restores <color=Highlight><te href=121005>Resonance Rate</te></color>.

skills.name: To Sculpt the Silence
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Seraphic Duo</color></size>
When casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 4</color>, enter <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> for {1}s. 
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Overture</color></size>
When Aemeath is in <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> and the <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> is no less than {0} points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Overture</color> at the cost of {29} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch into the Mech form after casting this skill and exit <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period of time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Seraphic Duet: Encore</color></size>
In the Mech form, when in <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> and the <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color> is no less than {0} points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Encore</color> at the cost of {29} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Switch back to Aemeath and exit the <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duo</color> state. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode</color></size>
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, when Resonators in the team respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, inflict <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> on the target for {4}s, stacking up to {3} times.
<size=10></size>
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, inflict <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=5} of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> for {7}s, stacking up to {6} times.
While in combat, when the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on targets near the active Resonator reaches {8} stacks, inflict {9} stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>. If the targets have more than {10} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, trigger <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> based on their max stack limit and remove all of their stacks.
<size=10></size>
In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> when the following skills deal damage. The same skill can only trigger this effect on the same target once every {27}s:
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath Stage 3 & 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech Stage 3 & 4</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color>, and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color>.
<size=10></size>
Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> removes <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> stacks on nearby targets and additionally deals {11} instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>, each time to a random target within range. For each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> removed from a target, the DMG Multiplier of the additional instances of Tune Rupture DMG triggered by <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> against the target is increased by {12}. This effect lasts for {28}s. The target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> does not affect the triggering of these instances of Tune Rupture DMG.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> removes the <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> stacks on targets if they are inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, and trigger the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the target based on its max stack limit without removing its stacks. Each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> removed from the target increases the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the main target by {13}.
<size=10></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Stardust Resonance</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> gains the following enhancements based on Aemeath's <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color>:
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> additionally deal {14} instances of <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>.
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> on the main target is additionally increased by {15}. The DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that provided by <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Starburst</color></size>
Active in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>. Deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> to targets within range that are affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, considered Tune Rupture DMG.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Starflux Thrust</color></size>
When in the Mech form and <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color> is more than {16}, use the Utility button to cast <color=Highlight>Starflux Thrust</color> and soar in the air by continuously consuming <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Synchronization Rate</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color> is capped at {17} points.
- Dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Mech</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Mech</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Mech</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Armament Merge</color>, and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Sync Strike: Call of Dawn</color> recovers <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
- Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color> and <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color> recovers {18} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> recovers {19} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
- When in <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121003>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</te></color> at the same time, casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II</color> recovers {21} points of <color=Highlight>Synchronization Rate</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Rate</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color> is capped at {22} points.
- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> recovers {23} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.
- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> recovers {24} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.
- When in <color=Highlight>Starlume Acceleration</color>, casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color> additionally recovers {25} point of <color=Highlight>Resonance Rate</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Starflux</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Starflux</color> is capped at {26} points.
<color=Highlight>Starflux</color> recovers naturally over time.

skills.name: Skillful Cooking
skills.descriptionTemplate: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: Silent Protection
skills.descriptionTemplate:
When casting this skill, the following effects are triggered based on the <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color> Aemeath is in:
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>: all Resonators in the team except Aemeath gain {0} All-DMG Amplification for {1}s. The All-DMG Amplification effect is increased to {2} for Resonators who inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color>.
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>: all Resonators in the team except Aemeath gain {0} All-DMG Amplification for {1}s. The All-DMG Amplification effect is increased to {2} for Resonators who inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>.
Casting this skill resets the effects above.

skills.name: Unlanded Melody
skills.descriptionTemplate:
When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Aemeath can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.
<size=10></size>
Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>: when Resonators in the team trigger <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target and cause them to be affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>, Aemeath triggers <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture Response - Starburst</color>. The same target can only be damaged by this skill once every {0}s.

chains.name: Gilded Glimmer of the First Dawn
chains.descriptionTemplate:
In <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color> gain {2} Crit. DMG increase and continuously pull in nearby target while charging.
<size=10></size>
When Aemeath remains in a state that meets all of the following conditions for over {1}s, she enters <color=Highlight>Instant Response - Brilliance</color>:
- Out of combat;
- Not performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color>, or Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color>.
<color=Highlight>Instant Response: Brilliance</color> inherits all effects of <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color> and remains active even when out of the duration of <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</color>. 
When in <color=Highlight>Instant Response - Brilliance</color> and not in <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Unbound</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath Charged II</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech Charged II</color> grants {5} points of <color=Highlight><te href=121004>Synchronization Rate</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Aemeath defeats a target affected by <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, she enters <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color> for {3}s.
While in <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color> or <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color>, Aemeath records the highest stack count of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> among the targets defeated.
Her next skill that directly damages the target immediately inflicts the targets with the recorded stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>, up to the current max limit of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color>. This ends <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color> and Aemeath cannot enter <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Tune Rupture</color> or <color=Highlight>Sealed Trail - Fusion Burst</color> for {4}s.

chains.name: Downy Notes of Snowfluff
chains.descriptionTemplate:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Overture</color> is increased by {0}.
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Seraphic Duet: Encore</color> is increased by {0}.
<size=10></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, when the additional instances <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> hit the same target, the DMG Multiplier of the <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> against this target is increased by {1} for {2}s, stacking up to {3} times.
<size=10></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, gain the following effects:
- In the <color=Highlight><te href=121002>Stardust Resonance</te></color> state, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color> is further increased to {4} against the main target of the <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>.
- <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> now additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> triggered by Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color>. Each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> removed now provides a {5} DMG Multiplier increase to <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on the main target.
- In combat state, when a target near the active Resonator in the team is defeated, immediately trigger <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> based on the target's current stack limit of <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>.

chains.name: Fervor Sightly Burns Bright as New
chains.descriptionTemplate:
Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color>'s DMG Multiplier is increased by {0}.
Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Overdrive</color>'s DMG Multiplier is increased by {3}.
<size=10></size>
In <color=Highlight><te href=121001>Instant Response</te></color>, Aemeath now inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color> on nearby targets while casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Aemeath</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Mech</color>, based on her current Resonance Mode.
<size=10></size>
Inherent Skill <color=Highlight>Between the Stars</color> is replaced with the following effects:
<size=10></size>
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> or deal <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>, Aemeath's Crit. DMG is increased by {1}, and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> DMG is now Amplified by {2}.
Resonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.
<size=10></size>
- In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color>, when Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, Aemeath's Crit. DMG is increased by {1}, and Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Heavenfall Edict: Finale</color> DMG is now Amplified by {2}.
Resonators joining the team or switching Resonance Mode resets this effect.

chains.name: Ethereal Waltz on Binary Tides
chains.descriptionTemplate: When casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Songs Across the Universe</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Debut of Meteoric Radiance</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121008>Sync Strike</te></color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color>, Resonators in the team gain {0} All-Attribute DMG Bonus for {1}s.

chains.name: Voyage to the Astral Shore
chains.descriptionTemplate:
When Aemeath defeats a target directly with her skills, <color=Highlight><te href=121009>Starflux</te></color> is reset to {0}.
<size=10></size>
When taking fatal damage, Aemeath is knocked out and turns into <color=Highlight>2D Digital Ghost</color> for {2}s.
In the <color=Highlight>2D Digital Ghost</color> state, Aemeath grants Resonators in the team a Shield equal to {1} of her ATK for {3}s. As she exits from the <color=Highlight>2D Digital Ghost</color> state, she revives and recovers {4} of her Max HP and {5} points of Resonance Energy. This effect can be triggered once every {6} min.
When Aemeath revives, she exits the <color=Highlight>2D Digital Ghost</color> state and removes the Shield provided.

chains.name: A Zephyr-Kissed Journey to You
chains.descriptionTemplate:
Targets take {0} more Resonance Liberation DMG from Aemeath.
<size=10></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, Aemeath's Tune Rupture DMG can critically hit, with a fixed Crit. Rate of {1}, and fixed Crit. DMG of {2}.
<size=10></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color> and in combat state, Fusion Burst DMG triggered on targets near the active Resonator in the team can critically hit, with a fixed Crit. Rate of {3}, and fixed Crit. DMG of {4}.
<size=10></size>
The stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> inflicted on the target through Forte Circuit <color=Highlight>To Sculpt the Silence</color> is doubled.
<size=10></size>
In <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>/<color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Fusion Burst</color> and in combat, the max stack limit of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> on the targets near the active Resonator in the team is increased to {5}. While casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight><te href=121007>Seraphic Duet</te></color>, inflict {6} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=121012>Rupturous Trail</te></color>/<color=Highlight><te href=121013>Fusion Trail</te></color> on targets within range for {7}s.
<size=10></size>

skills.name: Hunter's Path
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Steelclash</color></size>
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> shortly after performing Heavy Attack to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack from mid-air, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Dodge Counter</color></size>
<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> after a successful Mid-air Dodge to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep</color></size>
When <te href=130602>Prowess</te> is full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Steelclash</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Backstep</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and consuming all Prowess.
- While in action, <color=Highlight>release</color> or <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> again within a certain period to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color> is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color></size>
Augusta whirls and lashes out with her Broadblade, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut</color></size>
<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump</color> when <te href=130602>Prowess</te> is full to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and consuming all Prowess.
If Prowess is full when casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade</color>, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill</color> or <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and consuming all Prowess.
If Prowess is full when casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Steelclash</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter – Heavy Attack: Steelclash</color>, <color=Highlight>release Normal Attack</color> after a certain period or <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Jump</color> again to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Uppercut</color>, dealing, <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and consuming all Prowess.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash</color></size>
When <te href=130602>Prowess</te> is full, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep</color></size>
When <te href=130603>Ascendancy</te> is full, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> following a successful Dodge on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Thunderoar: Backstep</color> in place of <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- <color=Highlight>Release</color> or <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> again within a certain period into the action to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Thunderoar: Spinslash</color> is available if Augusta remains on the ground for a certain period after this skill is interrupted.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Prowess</color></size>
Augusta can hold up to {0} points of Prowess.
- Prowess is obtained when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Steelclash</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Dodge Counter</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Heavy Attack: Steelclash</color> deals damage.
- Prowess is fully restored when casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare</color>.

skills.descriptionTemplate: Augusta leaps and slams down her Broadblade, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

skills.name: Sunward Conquest
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Sword of Eternal Oath</color></size>
<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} and release Resonance Liberation</color> to cast this skill. Augusta will sweep her Broadblade forward, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun</color></size>
When <te href=130604>Majesty</te> reaches {0} stacks, <color=Highlight>hold Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun</color>. Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun</color> costs no Resonance Energy but {0} stacks of Majesty instead.
- When casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Sublime is the Sun</color>, Augusta generates the <color=Highlight><te href=130605>Ruler's Realm</te></color> and enters the <color=Highlight><te href=130606>Sworn Allegiance</te></color> state for {1}s. Within this duration, time is temporarily stopped, and <color=Highlight>Resonator switching</color> is disabled. Only <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne</color>, <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> can be performed in the <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color> state. <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> is available while airborne.
- In the <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color> state, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press}</color> or <color=Highlight>hold Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne</color>. Augusta can walk on water without consuming STA in this state.
- Performing <color=Highlight>environmental, gameplay, or other interactions</color> ends <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color> without triggering <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne</color></size>
Deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. After casting <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Sunborne</color> {2} times, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Liberation</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color></size>
Deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG. Casting <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color> ends the <color=Highlight><te href=130606>Sworn Allegiance</te></color> state and consumes all stacks of <te href=130601>Crown of Wills</te> later. All other Resonators in the team will be made to leave the field.
- When <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color> ends, <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color> is automatically cast.
- During <color=Highlight>Sworn Allegiance</color>, <color=Highlight>hold Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sublime is the Sun - Everbright Protector</color> early.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Ruler's Realm</color></size>
- <color=Highlight>Ruler's Realm</color> lasts for {3}s.
- When Resonators in the team cast <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> within <color=Highlight>Ruler's Realm</color>, they gain a shield equal to {5} + {4} of Augusta's Max HP for {6}s. This effect is unstackable. This Shield will not be passed on to the incoming Resonator.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Majesty</color></size>
Augusta can hold up to 2 stacks of Majesty.
- 1 stack of Majesty is obtained when casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge</color>.
- 1 stack of Majesty is obtained when other Resonators in the team cast <color=Highlight>Outro Skill</color> under the effect of Augusta's <color=Highlight>Outro Skill - Battlesong of the Unyielding</color>.

skills.name: Blazing Valor
skills.descriptionTemplate:
When Augusta is out of combat for over {0}s, she gains the following effects that can be triggered once every {1}s:
- If <te href=130604>Majesty</te> is less than 1 stack, restore 1 stack.
- Fully restore <te href=130601>Crown of Wills</te>.

skills.name: Stride of Goldenflare
skills.descriptionTemplate: Deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

skills.name: Call Me By the Sun
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike</color></size>
When <te href=130603>Ascendancy</te> is full, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
- <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill</color> during the action to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Strike</color> can be re-cast shortly after being interrupted.
- <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color> can be cast some time again after being interrupted.
- Can be cast mid-air.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color></size>
Deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
- <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill</color> during the action to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color> can be re-cast shortly after being interrupted.
- <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge</color> can be cast some time again after being interrupted.
- Can only be cast mid-air.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Plunge</color></size>
Consume all <te href=130603>Ascendancy</te> to cast this skill, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Heavy Attack DMG.
- Casting this skill grants 1 stack of <te href=130604>Majesty</te>.
- Can only be cast mid-air.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Undying Sunlight: Strike</color></size>
When <te href=130603>Ascendancy</te> is full, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill</color> after a successful ground Dodge or <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill</color> after successful Mid-air Dodge to cast <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Undying Sunlight: Strike</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Skill DMG.
- <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill</color> during the action to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Undying Sunlight: Leap</color> can be cast again some time after being interrupted.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Ascendancy</color></size>
Augusta can hold up to {0} points of Ascendancy.
- Ascendancy is obtained when <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks</color> deal damage.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Stride of Goldenflare</color> restores {1} Ascendancy.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Warrior's Blade</color> restores {2} Ascendancy.

skills.name: Sword to Carve My Forms
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color></size>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Following <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color> Stage 4, inflict 1 stack of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on targets hit and summon <color=Highlight><te href=850186>Sword of Divinity's Shadow</te></color>.
Up to 1 <color=Highlight><te href=850186>Sword of Divinity's Shadow</te></color> may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.
 
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Cartethyia</color></size> 
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and summoning <color=Highlight><te href=850185>Sword of Discord's Shadow</te></color>. Can be performed in mid-air.
Up to 1 <color=Highlight><te href=850185>Sword of Discord's Shadow</te></color> may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.
This instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color></size>
Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button while airborne to perform Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, also considered <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after the <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color> recalls all <color=Highlight>Sword Shadows</color>. Based on the types and number of <color=Highlight> Sword Shadows</color> recalled, perform different forms of Plunging Attack and obtain the corresponding <color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color>, and <color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Cartethyia</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

skills.name: Sword to Bear Their Names
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Cartethyia</color></size>
Attack the target, launch nearby enemies, and then plunge them to the ground, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and inflicting 2 stacks of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on the targets hit. This instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>. Can be performed in mid-air.
Following <color=Highlight>Cartethyia - Resonance Skill</color>, summon <color=Highlight><te href=850184>Sword of Virtue's Shadow</te></color>.
Up to 1 <color=Highlight><te href=850184>Sword of Virtue's Shadow</te></color> may exist at the same time, lasting for 20s.

skills.name: A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color></size>
By reducing HP to 50% of the Max HP, <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> transforms into <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, unlocking new moves and entering the <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> state for 12s.
Can be performed in mid-air.
Entering <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> clears all <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>.
As <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> instantly trigger 1 instance of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG and reduce the <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> stack on the target hit by 1.
- Ending the state will not clear Resonance Energy.
- No HP cost when HP is below 50%.

<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> attacks restore <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit. When <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> reaches 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color>.

When <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> is below 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to transform back into <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>. When in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color> as Cartethyia consumes no Resonance Energy.

When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
- <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 4</color> will generate a force field to Stagnate the targets within the range.
- <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys's</color> resistance to interruption increases. 
<color=Highlight><te href=850181>Heart of Virtue</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.

When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>: 
<color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> DMG is Amplified by 50% and the damage interval is decreased by 50% for enemies within a certain distance from <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=850182>Mandate of Divinity</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.
 
When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has <color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>:
When casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 5</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> and <color=Highlight>Enhanced Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color> or after <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - May Tempest Break the Tides</color> deals damage, raise the <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> stacks on all nearby targets to the highest count among the targets.
<color=Highlight><te href=850183>Power of Discord</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Manifest</color> ends.
 
<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> will transform back to <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> during <color=Highlight>quest dialogues</color>, <color=Highlight>environmental interaction animations</color>, or using <color=Highlight>Utilities</color>.
<color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> can walk on water. Doing so on deep waters continuously consumes STA. When in walking state, <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> can step out of a high place and walk in mid-air by continuously consuming STA.
 
<size=40><color=Title>Avatar - Cartethyia</color></size>
As <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, when <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> is below 120 points, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia Stage 2</color> and temporarily transform back to <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color>, which pauses the timer on <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting the skill in mid-air performs <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color>.
 
<size=40><color=Title>Avatar - Fleurdelys</color></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, casting Resonance Liberation as <color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> performs <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 2</color> without consuming Resonance Energy and transforms her back to <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>, which resumes the timer on <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air. Casting this skill in mid-air performs <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 1</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color></size>
When <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color> has 120 points of <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - A Knight's Heartfelt Prayers</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Blade of Howling Squall</color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color>, ends <color=Highlight>Manifest</color>, restores 50% of Max HP, and then deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to all targets in an area along a straight line in front. Upon hitting the target, remove all stacks of <color=Wind><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on the target. Each stack removed Amplifies the DMG taken by the targets by 20%, up to 5 stacks.
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.descriptionTemplate:
<color=Highlight>Cartethyia</color> unlocks new moves when she transforms into <color=Highlight>Fleurdelys</color>:

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys</color></size> 
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.

<color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in the air at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> and restoring <color=Highlight><te href=850179>Conviction</te></color> on hit.

Follow up with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> shortly afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Fleurdelys Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Cartethyia</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Fleurdelys</color>.

<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa unlocks <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color>, <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> consume <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> on hit.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sawring - Blitz</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> chains up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.  
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to start the combo from <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 1</color>. Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to start from <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color> to continuously attack the target. <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color> is automatically followed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2</color>, release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> without directional input to automatically cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. Shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color>, successful Dodges can be triggered.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
While casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to continuously attack the target. <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> is automatically followed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>.
Release <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> during <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> to automatically cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
<color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> following a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> following <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while casting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to sustain the attack. When <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> ends, cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3</color> automatically.
Release the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button or <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> without directional input while casting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 2: Discordance</color> automatically.
<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> deals <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sawring - Eradication</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa casts <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> in the following 2 ways:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> after consuming all <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> with <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> or <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color>.
Attacking targets with <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color> deals <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and grants Shields to all nearby Resonators in the team for {5}s.
The skill DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation DMG</color>.
Every {6} point of <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> consumed by <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz</color> and <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode - Dodge Counter</color> increases the DMG Multiplier of the next <color=Highlight>Sawring - Eradication</color>. Up to {7} points will be counted toward this effect.
Casting this skill consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> and ends <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Chainsaw Fever</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color>.
<color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> is at 100% by default.
When Chisa goes on for a period without dealing any damage, <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa enters the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color> and exits <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color>, Chisa resets <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Fever</color> when dealing damage or when casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color>, Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> and <color=Highlight>Sawring - Blitz Stage 3: Falltone</color>.
While in the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150803>Ring of Chainsaw</te></color> will rapidly deplete. Once it reaches 0, Chisa exits the <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>.
When in <color=Highlight>Burnout State</color>, Chisa exits the state upon dealing damage, or casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lifethread - Glide</color></size>
When Chisa is not in <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> and has more than {3} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color>, she can consume {8} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150804>Lifethread - Jetstream</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color> in the following 5 ways:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> in mid-air before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>.
- While in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> or <color=Highlight>Rending Lunge</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> forward shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Thread Withdrawn</color>.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing when launched into mid-air.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> before landing after casting <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.
Casting this skill can pull in nearby enemies marked by <color=Highlight><te href=150801>Unseen Snare</te></color>.
During the skill, hold <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to glide a short distance on the weapon.
Can trigger successful Dodges within a certain time after casting this skill.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Ring of Chainsaw</color></size>
Chisa can hold up to {9} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Normal Attack </color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Eye of Unraveling</color> grants <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Moment of Nihility</color> grants {10} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Reverberance - Return</color> grants {11} points of <color=Highlight>Ring of Chainsaw</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lifethread - Jetstream</color></size>
Chisa can hold up to {12} points of <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color>. 
Chisa continuously obtains <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> over time.
Chisa obtains {13} points of <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> upon defeating a target. 
Exiting <color=Highlight>Chainsaw Mode</color> resets <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> to the max limit.
Chisa cannot obtain <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Jetstream</color> passively for a short period of time after casting  <color=Highlight>Lifethread - Glide</color>.

skills.name: Quadruple Time Steps
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title> Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. Basic Attack Stage 4 inflicts 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> upon the target hit.
- When the first three stages of Ciaccona's Basic Attack are interrupted by dodging, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Basic Attack in time to resume the attack cycle and cast the corresponding Basic Attack stage.
- After Basic Attack Stage 4, Ciaccona starts a <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>. If Ciaccona's Basic Attack Stage 4 or <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> ends early (proactively or being interrupted), an <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylph</color> is generated.

<size=40><color=Title>Solo Concert</color></size>
When Ciaccona or Ensemble Sylph performs Solo Concert, they give 24% Aero DMG Bonus to all nearby Resonators in the team. This effect is not stackable.

<size=40><color=Title>Ensemble Sylph</color></size>
Up to 2 Ensemble Sylphs may exist simultaneously.
If Ciaccona's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> is interrupted, the Ensemble Sylphs generated will finish the attack for Ciaccona and enter <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>.
If Ciaccona's <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> is interrupted, the <color=Highlight>Ensemble Sylphs</color> generated will continue the <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color> for Ciaccona.
Aside from the two situations mentioned above, Ensemble Sylphs generated by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> will finish Ciaccona's current attack without entering <color=Highlight>Solo Concert</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to jump into mid-air and attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Aimed Attack</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Aim to enter Aiming Mode to fire charged shots, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after Mid-air Attack Stage 2 to cast Basic Attack Stage 4.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>

skills.descriptionTemplate:

<size=40><color=Title>Recital</color></size>
When in Recital, sound waves will periodically radiate around Ciaccona. When the sound wave overlaps with the circle indicator, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} the green or yellow buttons to generate <color=Highlight>Symphonic Poem: Tonic</color> of the corresponding color and recover a certain amount of Concerto Energy.
During Recital:
- Switching to another Resonator doesn't end Recital, but automatically generates a <color=Highlight>Symphonic Poem: Tonic</color> matching the color of the last generated Tonic before switching. A green <color=Highlight>Symphonic Poem: Tonic</color> is generated by default if no interaction input is given before switching to another Resonator.
- Ciaccona is immune to interruptions and takes {0} less DMG.
- Exit Recital by {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} Resonance Liberation again or switching Ciaccona back onto the field.
- <color=Highlight><te href=850059>Ensemble Sylphs</te></color> can now directly grant Aero DMG Bonus provided by <color=Highlight><te href=850060>Solo Concert</te></color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Symphonic Poem: Tonic</color></size>
Green Tonic: Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets and inflict a stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> on targets hit.
Yellow Tonic: Deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets and inflict a stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> on targets hit.

<size=40><color=Title>Threshold State</color></size>
By default, Galbrena is in <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, and in this state, she accumulates <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Demon Hypostasis</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>, Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Volley of Death, Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage, Dodge Counter - Blood for Blood, and Resonance Skill - Encroach are replaced with Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution, Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict, Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage, Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge, and Resonance Skill - Ravage, which consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>, every point of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> increases the DMG of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge</color> by {0}, up to {1}, which is removed upon exiting <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.
When <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> depletes or after staying in <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color> for over 50s, <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color> ends automatically.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color></size>
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. Stage 1 to 3 DMG are considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>, and Stage 4 & 5 DMG <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 5</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color></size>
Consume STA to attack the target and perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. Stage 3 DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict Stage 2 & 3</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>. 
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage</color></size>
While in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack to consume STA to perform aerial attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit.
While in mid-air, hold Normal Attack to continuously consume STA to launch a barrage of shots at targets, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. If Galbrena does not land when interrupted during the barrage, she cannot immediately cast this skill again. Release Normal Attack during the barrage to cast Plunging Attack. 
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after the Plunging Attack to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 3</color>. 
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Purgatory Scourge</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution Stage 4</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color></size>
Dash forward and leap into the air. Flip backward upon hitting the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Consume <color=Highlight><te href=120803>Purging Flame</te></color> on hit. <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color> share a cooldown.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Hellstride</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge on the ground while casting <color=Highlight>Galbrena's own skills</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> to deal a fixed amount of <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG that does not bear any effect from DMG buffs. <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> can trigger successful Dodges. <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color> cannot be cast consecutively.
Casting this skill does not reset the attack cycles within a short period of time.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Burning Drive</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Hellstride</color>, <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Seraphic Execution Basic Attack Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> increases Galbrena's resistance to interruptions and ATK by {2} for {3}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Afterflame</color></size>
Galbrena can hold up to 40 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, Galbrena recovers 8 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> when Resonators in the nearby team cast Echo Skill. Echoes with the same name can only trigger this effect once. This effect resets when Galbrena exits <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.
All <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> is removed upon exiting <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sinflame</color></size>
Galbrena can hold up to 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120804>Threshold State</te></color>, hitting an enemy with Basic Attack, Heavy Attack - Volley of Death, Mid-air Attack - Ashfall Barrage, Resonance Skill - Encroach, and Intro Skill - Hellflare Overload recovers <color=Highlight><te href=120802>Sinflame</te></color>.

chains.descriptionTemplate: The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Encroach</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice</color>, and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color> are increased by {0}.

chains.name: I Remain Who I am, Eternal My Flame
chains.descriptionTemplate:
<color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color> becomes <color=Highlight><te href=120806>Eternal Hypostasis</te></color>. <color=Highlight><te href=120806>Eternal Hypostasis</te></color> retains all effects of <color=Highlight><te href=120805>Demon Hypostasis</te></color>.
Additionally, <color=Highlight><te href=120806>Eternal Hypostasis</te></color> lasts, the DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color>,  <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter -Purgatory Scourge</color> are additionally increased by {0}.
<size=10></size>
When casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ascent of Malice</color>, for every 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=120801>Afterflame</te></color> consumed, Galbrena's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Seraphic Execution</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flamewing Verdict</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Hellsent Barrage</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Ravage</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter -Purgatory Scourge</color> gain {1} Fusion DMG Amplification, up to {2}, which is removed upon exiting <color=Highlight><te href=120806>Eternal Hypostasis</te></color>.

skills.name: Flaming Sakura Blade Art
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Present Self</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> consecutively or hold it down to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color> applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color></size>
When <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> reaches 300 points, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color> becomes available.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to shoot out 3 arrows one by one at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions and incoming DMG in the duration.
When the last arrow is shot, 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> is consumed and <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> becomes available. The arrow applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Present Self</color></size>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack from Mid-air, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Present Self</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3, 4, and 5</color> each applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color></size>
In <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Hold Breath</color>, continuously consuming STA. When <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> is released or STA is depleted, Hiyuki leaves the <color=Highlight>Hold Breath</color> state and thrusts forward, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2</color>.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during the thrust, neutralize that instance of damage, Stagnate nearby targets, and become immune to interruptions for a certain period afterward while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after triggering this effect to chain into <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4</color> instead.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color></size>
When <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color> is full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>. 
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> and consume STA and 3 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color> to gain 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.
If Hiyuki is airborne while casting this skill, she'll land on the ground first.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>.
Consume STA to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks in Mid-air, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG. Stage 3 is a Plunging Attack.
<color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2 & 3</color> apply <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.
The <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color> cycle will not be reset by casting skills other than <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> within a short period.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3</color>.
