skills.name: Frostblight
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color></size>
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
Casting this skill enhances the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>, which now restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> when cast. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>.
<size=10></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> and <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>:
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color></size>
While on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to pull in nearby targets and deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, removing the targets' <color=Highlight><te href=110808>Frostbind</te></color>.
This skill shares a Cooldown with <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Frostblight: Petalfall</color></size>
While in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to pull in nearby targets and deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, removing the targets' <color=Highlight><te href=110808>Frostbind</te></color>.
This skill shares a Cooldown with <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>.

skills.name: Foreclaiming
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> becomes available after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast this skill, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Upon casting this skill, gain 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>, remove 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>. Then, enter <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color> and restore 50 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>.
<color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> applies 4 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on hit.
Casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> does not consume Resonance Energy.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color> can be cast via the following ways:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> and release to cast <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color>. If Hiyuki has 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>, consume all <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>. Otherwise, this cast does not consume <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>.
- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to enter a charging state. During this state, consume 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> periodically. Release <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color>. If no <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> is consumed when <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> is released, Hiyuki will continue to charge the attack and cast the skill automatically after certain time. <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color> will also be cast automatically when <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> depletes. 
Hiyuki deals <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. Each point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> consumed increases the DMG Multiplier of this attack.
Casting the skill consumes 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>, and ends <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>.

skills.name: Fine Snow
skills.descriptionTemplate:
When a Resonator in the team applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>. <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color> stacks up to {0} times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once in this way.
Based on Hiyuki's current stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>, the following bonuses are unlocked:
1 stack of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is Amplified by {1} against targets within a certain range. Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by {2}.
2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color>, she additionally deals an instance of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> with a fixed DMG Multiplier of {3}.
3 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>: When Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is additionally Amplified by {4} against targets within a certain range.
This effect resets when new Resonators are added to the team.

skills.name: Ephemeral Realm
skills.descriptionTemplate: Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers after being knocked out, when she stays out of combat for 4s with fewer than 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>, restore 1 point.

skills.name: Frostedge
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG, and apply <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.
In <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>, casting this skill restores 200 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>.
In <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 2</color>.

skills.name: Everfrost Dominion
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Glacio Bite</color></size>
- While Hiyuki is in the team, <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> inflicted by nearby Resonators in the team is converted to <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>. Every time a new stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> is inflicted on a target, an instance of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is triggered based on that enemy's current <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> stack limit. <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> can be inflicted on <color=Highlight>frozen</color> targets. <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> is also considered <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> is also considered <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te> DMG</color>.
- When <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> hits a target, if the target has no fewer than {0} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>, consume <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} and trigger <color=Highlight><te href=110808>Frostbind</te></color> once. 
- When Hiyuki joins the team, remove all stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> from the targets. When Hiyuki leaves the team, if there is no other Resonator in the team who can convert <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> into <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color>, all enemies' <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te></color> stacks are cleared.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Present Self</color></size>
Hiyuki starts in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>. While in <color=Highlight><te href=110806>Present Self</te></color>, casting certain skills restores <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Foreclaimed Self</color></size>
Hiyuki enters <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color> after casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color>. While in <color=Highlight><te href=110807>Foreclaimed Self</te></color>, Hiyuki unlocks new moves and restores <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> through certain attacks.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Iai Stance</color></size>
If Hiyuki has at least 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>, performing any of the following actions causes her to flash backward at the cost of STA and enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>:
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> after casting any <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> other than <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color>.
- Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> within a certain period after casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> or <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.
While performing the actions above, if there is a valid target within the range and the forward input is held down, Hiyuki instead flashes behind the enemy at the cost of STA and enters <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>.
Hiyuki may enter <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> while airborne. Upon entering the <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, Hiyuki's mid-air Dodge charges are reset. <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color> ends if Hiyuki is switched out.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Iai</color></size>
Within a certain period after entering <color=Highlight>Iai Stance</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> and consume 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
If <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> remains at 100 points or above after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain period to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> again.
If Hiyuki is attacked by an enemy within a certain period during <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, neutralize this instance of damage and become immune to interruptions for a certain duration afterwards while reducing all incoming DMG by 100%.
Each time <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color> is cast, if Hiyuki has <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>, consume 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> to inflict 3 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> on hit, and gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dedication</color></size>
Hiyuki holds up to  300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Present Self</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color> may be restored via the following ways:
- Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color> restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Frostedge</color> restores 200 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color> enhances the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>, which now additionally restores 100 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110801>Dedication</te></color>. This effect ends when Hiyuki is switched out.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Frostheart</color></size>
Hiyuki holds up to 300 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color>.
<color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> is restored while casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> and <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>, or when <color=Highlight>Normal Attacks - Foreclaimed Self</color> other than <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> hits the target.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Frostharden Iai</color></size>
<color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> has a maximum of 3 points.
Casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> grants 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Whiteout Bitterfrost</color></size>
<color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color> stacks up to 3 times.
Each time <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color> is consumed through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>, gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110804>Whiteout Bitterfrost</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Snowforged Blade</color></size>
<color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color> stacks up to 3 times.
Each time <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> is cast, gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>.

skills.name: Skillful Cooking
skills.descriptionTemplate: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: Snowlight Blessing
skills.descriptionTemplate: Glacio DMG dealt by nearby Resonators other than Hiyuki in the team is Amplified by {0} against targets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> for {1}s.

skills.name: Tune Break: Sword
skills.descriptionTemplate:
When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Hiyuki can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.
<size=10></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Present Self</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Present Self Stage 3</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3</color>.

chains.name: Springless
chains.descriptionTemplate:
The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Foreclaimed Self</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Foreclaimed Self</color> are increased by {0}.
<size=10></size>
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 3</color> now has an increased range and pulls enemies within range toward the center. Hiyuki is immune to interruptions while casting  <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 4 & 5</color>.
<size=10></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> enhances the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Foreclaimed Self Stage 1 & 2</color>, which now inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> 1 time on hit.

chains.name: To Burn Cold in Silence
chains.descriptionTemplate:
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iai</color>'s DMG Multiplier is increased by {0}.
<size=10></size>
Inherent Skill <color=Highlight>Ephemeral Realm</color>'s effect becomes the following one:
Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers from being knocked out, after staying out of combat for 4s, restore <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=110805>Snowforged Blade</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
Once Hiyuki leaves the combat state or recovers from being knocked out, after staying out of combat for {2}s, the following effects are triggered once:
- While in <color=Highlight>Foreclaimed Self</color>, restore <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} points of <color=Highlight><te href=110803>Frostharden Iai</te></color>.
- Reset the Cooldown of <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=charge P=charges SapTag=4} of <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>.
- Restore an additional {6} points of <color=Highlight><te href=110802>Frostheart</te></color> for the next <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=cast P=casts SapTag=5} of <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> or <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.

chains.name: No Self, No Bound
chains.descriptionTemplate:
Inherent Skill <color=Highlight>Fine Snow</color> gains the following effect:
{0}s after a Resonator joins the team or Hiyuki is revived, Hiyuki gains 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>. Hiyuki can obtain up to 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color> in this way.
<size=10></size>
The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Frost Splinter: Present Self</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Bitterfrost: Foreclaimed Self</color> are increased by {1}.
<size=10></size>
At 2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>, while Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, the DMG Multiplier of the additionally applied Glacio Bite DMG each time she inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color> is increased by {2}.

Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Present Self</color>, <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color>, or <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color> increases the DMG dealt by all nearby Resonators in the team by {0} for {1}s.
<size=10></size>
Restore {2} of Max HP while casting <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Jade Cleave</color> or <color=Highlight>Frostblight: Petalfall</color>.

chains.name: Into a Night Without End
chains.descriptionTemplate:
The Crit. DMG of <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Inward Vision</color> and <color=Highlight>Foreclaiming: Blade Liberation</color> is increased by {0}.
<size=10></size>
At 2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>, the effect "While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time she applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color>, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier" changes to "While Hiyuki is the active Resonator in the team, each time a Resonator in the team applies <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color>, she additionally deals an instance of Glacio Bite DMG with a fixed DMG Multiplier."
At 2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>, Hiyuki's Crit. DMG is increased by {1}.
At 3 stacks of <color=Highlight>Snow Rust</color>, the total <color=Highlight><te href=110809>Glacio Bite</te> DMG</color> taken by targets within a certain range of the active Resonator in the team is increased by {2}.

skills.name: Manifold Bloom
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Answering Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Answering Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, consume STA to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Answering Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> and in mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> and in mid-air, hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color>, continuously consuming STA and dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target.
Depleting all STA or switching to another Resonator ends the skill action early.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color></size>
When the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> button is released during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color>, Hsin casts <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color>, consuming STA to perform a Plunging Attack, transforming into the Moon Fox upon landing and dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Answering Form: Reign at Ease</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Answering Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Illumining Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and not in the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1</color> generates a <color=Highlight>Modular Heartlock</color> at the target's position. Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color> causes the <color=Highlight>Modular Heartlock</color> to collapse, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
Casting this skill consumes STA when Hsin is in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, consume STA to command Xuanfang Mechanisms, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Upward Cut - Illumining Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to cast this skill, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and Hsin is in mid-air, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form</color>.
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and in the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state, command Xuanfang Mechanisms to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and in the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned Stage 3</color>.

skills.name: Heartward by Moon
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Answering Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.

If Hsin moves while on the ground within a short time after casting this skill, she turns into the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color>. 
- While in the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> form and out of combat, Hsin gains <color=Highlight>Dustless Tread</color>. With <color=Highlight>Dustless Tread</color>, Hsin can enter the target's aggro range without triggering combat. <color=Highlight>Dustless Tread</color> is removed when Hsin enters combat, is switched out, or ends the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> form by having environmental, gameplay, or feature interactions.
- While in the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> form and out of combat, Hsin restores {0} of Max HP every {1}s.
- Taking damage, failing to perform a <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> with directional input while on the ground, or <color=Highlight>Dodging</color> in mid-air will end the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> form. Switching to another Resonator or {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapping PC=pressing Gamepad=pressing} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> also ends the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> form. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4</color>, which also ends the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> form.
- The Dash state continuously consumes STA when Hsin is in the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> form.
- <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> is disabled when Hsin is in the <color=Highlight>Moon Fox</color> form.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and Hsin is on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to have Hsin command a Colossal Xuanfang Mechanism, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

skills.name: Nexus Alight
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Formshift</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector</color> unlocks <color=Highlight>Formshift</color>.
Cast <color=Highlight>Formshift</color> to unfurl the Manifold Sanctum. Hsin switches to <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, unlocking a new set of combat abilities, and enters the <color=Highlight><te href=131120>Heart Manifest</te></color> state.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, engaging in <color=Highlight>quest dialogue</color>, performing an <color=Highlight>environmental interaction with an animation</color>, or using a <color=Highlight>Utility</color> switches Hsin back to <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> to perform the corresponding action.
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, Hsin can walk on the surface of water, and will continuously consume STA in deep water areas. In Walking Mode, Hsin in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> can step off a cliff into the air and walk slowly in mid-air, continuously consuming STA in this state. Hsin cannot restore STA while in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Pillars Across Heaven</color></size>
After casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons</color>, when in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> with full Resonance Energy, <color=Highlight>Pillars Across Heaven</color> becomes available.
Cast <color=Highlight>Pillars Across Heaven</color> to bring the Manifold Sanctum crashing down, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
Hsin returns to <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> and exits the <color=Highlight><te href=131120>Heart Manifest</te></color> state.

<size=40><color=Title>Edict</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Formshift</color> grants Hsin <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight>Edict</color> for {2}s. The effect cannot exceed <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} and all stacks are removed when the duration ends.
After a Resonator on the field deals DMG, Hsin automatically consumes <color=Highlight>Edict</color> in the following {1}s to trigger the following effect up to once per second. Retriggering the effect resets the duration:
- When <color=Highlight>Edict</color> is consumed, summon a <color=Highlight>Soaring Pillar</color> from the Manifold Sanctum as a Coordinated Attack to strike the target once, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. 
- <color=Highlight>Edict</color> can be automatically consumed up to 1 stack per second.
- Damage dealt by <color=Highlight>Soaring Pillar</color> does not trigger this effect.
- When Hsin is knocked out, all <color=Highlight>Edict</color> stacks are removed.

<size=40><color=Title>Heart Manifest</color></size>
Increases Hsin's resistance to interruption for {2}s.
Entering the <color=Highlight>Heart Manifest</color> state resets Hsin's <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>.
While in the <color=Highlight>Heart Manifest</color> state and in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, if <color=Highlight>Pillars Across Heaven</color> is locked, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to have Hsin cast <color=Highlight>Invoked Form: Answering</color>. While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to have Hsin cast <color=Highlight>Invoked Form: Illumining</color>.
Besides, if Hsin is still in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> after exiting <color=Highlight>Heart Manifest</color>, and <color=Highlight>Pillars Across Heaven</color> is locked, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color> to have Hsin cast <color=Highlight>Invoked Form: Answering</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Invoked Form: Answering</color></size>
Hsin temporarily reverts to <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 2</color>; if She is in mid-air, She casts <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Answering Form</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Invoked Form: Illumining</color></size>
Hsin turns back into <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>. When this skill is cast, if Hsin is on the ground, She casts <color=Highlight>Upward Cut - Illumining Form</color>; if She is in mid-air, She casts <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Illumining Form</color>.

skills.name: Tides of Succession
skills.descriptionTemplate:
While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>, when Hsin casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison</color>, Her ATK is increased by {0} for {1}s. Switching to another Resonator or Resonance Mode ends this effect.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>, after Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>, Hsin gains {2} Electro DMG Bonus, stacking up to {3} times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once. In addition, if Rover: Electro is in the same team, when Rover: Electro casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury</color>, both Hsin and Rover: Electro gain {6} Electro DMG Bonus for {7}s.
This effect resets when a Resonator is added to the team or when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

skills.name: Gleaning Simple Joys
skills.descriptionTemplate:
While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>, the maximum stacks of the <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> effect on Resonators in the team are increased by {0}. When a Resonator in the team triggers <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color>, all Resonators in the team gain <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> for {2}s. This effect does not stack.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color> and Hsin is not in the <color=Highlight><te href=131120>Heart Manifest</te></color> state, after Resonators in the team other than Hsin inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on a target, every 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> inflicted grants Hisn 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Thunderglow</color>, stacking up to {1} times.
While Hsin is in the <color=Highlight><te href=131120>Heart Manifest</te></color> state, when targets within a certain range have 0 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>, inflict 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the targets. If <color=Highlight>Thunderglow</color> on Hsin reaches the stack limit, Hsin also inflicts <color=Highlight>Fleeting Thunder</color> on the targets:
- When Hsin inflicts <color=Highlight>Fleeting Thunder</color> on the target, She also inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the target to the stack limit, up to {3} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>.
- When <color=Highlight>Fleeting Thunder</color> is active, if the maximum stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the target is increased, Hsin will inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the target to the stack limit again, up to {3} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>.
- <color=Highlight>Fleeting Thunder</color> will be removed when the target leaves the designated range around Hsin.
Exiting the <color=Highlight><te href=131120>Heart Manifest</te></color> state or switching Resonance Mode removes the aforementioned effects.

skills.name: Glance on a Whim
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Intro Skill - Answering Form</color></size>
This skill becomes available while in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>. Attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3</color> (when in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>) or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 4</color> (when in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>).

<size=40><color=Title>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color></size>
This skill becomes available while in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>. Attack the target, dealing greater <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
After casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a short time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Answering Form Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Intro Skill - Illumining Form</color></size>
This skill becomes available while in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>. Attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison</color></size>
This skill becomes available while in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>. Attack the target, dealing greater <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.

skills.name: Forms Turn, Heart Abides
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Forms Born of Heart</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, Hsin can gain and consume <color=Highlight><te href=131117>Answering Heart</te></color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, Hsin can gain and consume <color=Highlight><te href=131118>Illumining Heart</te></color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, when Hsin's <color=Highlight><te href=131117>Answering Heart</te></color> reaches {0} points, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast the skill at the cost of STA and {0} points of <color=Highlight><te href=131117>Answering Heart</te></color>. Hsin is immune to interruption during the action, and deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color> grants Hsin <color=Highlight><te href=131114>Resolution of Wishes</te></color>. This <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color> consumes <color=Highlight><te href=131114>Resolution of Wishes</te></color> to become <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector</color>, dealing greater DMG. <color=Highlight><te href=131114>Resolution of Wishes</te></color> can only be gained once every {16}s.
While casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector</color>, if Hsin is not in the <color=Highlight><te href=131120>Heart Manifest</te></color> state, unlock <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, when Hsin's <color=Highlight><te href=131118>Illumining Heart</te></color> reaches 0 during the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast the skill at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target, considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color> grants Hsin <color=Highlight><te href=131115>Law of Heaven</te></color>. This <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color> consumes <color=Highlight><te href=131115>Law of Heaven</te></color> to become <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons</color>, dealing greater DMG. <color=Highlight><te href=131115>Law of Heaven</te></color> can only be gained once every {16}s.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons</color> ends the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state and unlocks <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, when Hsin's <color=Highlight><te href=131118>Illumining Heart</te></color> reaches {1} points and She is on the ground, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color>.
When Hsin is on the ground, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to deal <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to surrounding targets.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color> sends Hsin into the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state.

<size=40><color=Title>Mechanism Dominion</color></size>
The <color=Highlight>Mechanism Dominion</color> state lasts {2}s.
While this state is active, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color>.
When <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color> hits a target, <color=Highlight><te href=131118>Illumining Heart</te></color> is consumed if Hsin is the active Resonator.
Exiting <color=Highlight>Mechanism Dominion</color> clears <color=Highlight><te href=131118>Illumining Heart</te></color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode - Unison</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>, Hsin gains the following effects:
- Hsin can trigger <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color>, but not in Co-op Mode.
- After casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color>, the next <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color> grants Hsin <color=Highlight><te href=131110>Unison</te></color> for {17}s.
- When Hsin triggers <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color>, She gains <color=Highlight>Source Intent</color>, and this cast of <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Manifold Unison</color>, dealing greater DMG.
When Hsin casts an <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> without triggering <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color> while holding <color=Highlight>Source Intent</color>, She consumes <color=Highlight>Source Intent</color> instead, and the <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Manifold Unison</color>, dealing greater DMG.
- The aforementioned effects are removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison</color> sends Hsin directly into the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>, Hsin gains the following effects:
- When Hsin enters combat, targets within a certain range do not lose <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> stacks when it's triggered.
- After Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150806>Electro Rage</te></color> on a target, every <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4} of <color=Highlight><te href=150806>Electro Rage</te></color> inflicted grants Hsin <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of <color=Highlight>Heart of Thunder</color>, stacking up to {5} times, and consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=150806>Electro Rage</te></color> stacks from that target. <color=Highlight>Heart of Thunder</color> is removed when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
- At the last stage of <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon</color>, Hsin actively triggers 1 instance of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG on the targets. Its DMG Multiplier is equal to {9} x (the number of <color=Highlight>Heart of Thunder</color> stacks on Hsin) x (the <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> stacks).
While casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon</color>, switching to another Resonator or ending the skill early removes the above effects.
Some time after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon</color>, Hsin consumes all remaining stacks of <color=Highlight>Heart of Thunder</color>.
When Hsin has at least {24} stacks of <color=Highlight>Heart of Thunder</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color> stagnates nearby targets during the action.
- After casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color>, inflict <SapTag=E>{18}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=E} of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on nearby targets within a certain range. It also makes <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color> inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on hit targets, up to <SapTag=A>{12}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=A}. Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color> again resets this count. Switching Resonance Mode removes it.
<color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form: Pillars Aligned</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons</color> inflict <SapTag=E>{18}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=E} of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the target hit. <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector</color> inflict <SapTag=F>{19}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=F} of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> on the target hit.

<size=40><color=Title>Unison</color></size>
While Hsin is in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color> with <color=Highlight>Unison</color>, switching to another Resonator will remove Hsin's <color=Highlight>Unison</color> to trigger Hsin's Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator's Intro Skill. If Hsin has full Concerto Energy and <color=Highlight>Unison</color> at the same time, only <color=Highlight>Unison</color> is consumed to trigger the effect.

<size=40><color=Title>Unison Response</color></size>
While Hsin is in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color> and the active Resonator in the team has <color=Highlight><te href=131110>Unison</te></color>, Hsin triggers <color=Highlight>Unison Response</color> after She is switched in and casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, granting <SapTag=G>{20}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=G} of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> to all Resonators in the team for {21}s.
Hsin can only grant up to <SapTag=G>{20}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=G} of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> in this way.

<size=40><color=Title>Unison Boon</color></size>
Only the Resonators who can trigger Unison Response can gain this effect. Each stack of <color=Highlight>Unison Boon</color> increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators who can trigger <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color> in the team by {22}, stacking up to {23} times.

<size=40><color=Title>Answering Heart</color></size>
Can hold up to {0} points of <color=Highlight>Answering Heart</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color>, when <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Answering Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Answering Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color> hits a target, Hsin gains <color=Highlight>Answering Heart</color> if She is the active Resonator.
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color> grants {13} points of <color=Highlight>Answering Heart</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Illumining Heart</color></size>
Can hold up to {1} points of <color=Highlight>Illumining Heart</color>.
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> and not in the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state, when <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Illumining Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form</color> hits a target, Hsin gains <color=Highlight>Illumining Heart</color> if She is the active Resonator.
- While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form</color> or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison</color> directly sends Hsin into the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state and grants {10} points of <color=Highlight>Illumining Heart</color>.
- While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>, after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color>, when the <color=Highlight>Modular Heartlock</color> generated by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 1</color> is collapsed by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Illumining Form Stage 2</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Illumining Form</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Illumining Form</color>, additionally gain {11} points of <color=Highlight>Illumining Heart</color> if Hsin is the active Resonator in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color> but not in the <color=Highlight><te href=131116>Mechanism Dominion</te></color> state. This effect can only be triggered once before the next cast of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color> resets it, and is disabled when switched to the other Resonance Mode.

chains.name: A Boat to Cross the Rising Tide
chains.descriptionTemplate:
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Formshift</color> grants Hsin 2 stacks of <color=Highlight>Radiance Ward</color>, stacking up to {0} times. Switching to <color=Highlight>Answering Form</color> clears all stacks. When Hsin takes DMG from an enemy target's attack, 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Radiance Ward</color> can be consumed to make Her immune to interruption and reduce DMG taken by {1} for {2}s. This effect can be triggered once every {3}s.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>:
The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison</color> are increased by {6}, and each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> additionally increases the DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison</color> by {7}, up to a total of {8} stacks.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>:
When Hsin enters combat, if <color=Highlight><te href=131113>Heart of Thunder</te></color> is below {13} stacks, it is increased to {13} stacks, triggered once every {12}s.
The DMG Multiplier of the <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG triggered by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon</color> is increased to {16} x (the number of <color=Highlight>Heart of Thunder</color> stacks on Hsin) x (the <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> stacks).

chains.name: To Wake Is to Wonder What I Am
chains.descriptionTemplate:

The DMG Multipliers of <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons</color> are increased by {1}.

When Hsin enters combat, reset the Cooldowns for Hsin to gain <color=Highlight><te href=131114>Resolution of Wishes</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=131115>Law of Heaven</te></color>, and restore {2} additional points of <color=Highlight><te href=131117>Answering Heart</te></color>. This effect can be triggered once every {3}s.

chains.name: A Dream of Return Among the Hills
chains.descriptionTemplate:
The DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven</color> is increased by {0}.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>:
The Crit. DMG of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven</color> is increased by {1}, and each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> additionally increases its Crit. DMG by {2}, up to a total of {3} stacks.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>:
When the last stage of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven</color> hits a target inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>, it triggers 1 instance of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG, with its DMG Multiplier equal to {4} times the <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG Multiplier corresponding to the current <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> stacks on the target.

chains.name: A River of Lanterns, a River of Wishes
chains.descriptionTemplate:
All Resonators in the team gain {0} All-Attribute DMG Bonus for {1}s when a Resonator in the team triggers any of the following actions:
- Inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=150806>Electro Rage</te></color> on a target.
- Gain <color=Highlight><te href=131110>Unison</te></color> while not having the effect.
- Trigger <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color>.

chains.name: Forms Turn as the Heart Wills
chains.descriptionTemplate:
While in <color=Highlight>Illumining Form</color>, DMG taken by Hsin is reduced by {0}.
When Hsin takes a fatal blow, She will not be knocked out, but instead restores {1} of Max HP and becomes immune to DMG and interruption for {2}s. This effect can be triggered once every <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=minute P=minutes SapTag=3}.

chains.name: The Moon Owes Its Light to the Living
chains.descriptionTemplate:
Targets take {0} more Resonance Skill DMG from Hsin.

Resonance Skill DMG dealt by Hsin ignores {2} of the target's DEF.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Unison</color>:
The maximum stacks of the <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> effect on Resonators in the team are additionally increased by {1}. When a Resonator in the team triggers <color=Highlight><te href=131112>Unison Response</te></color>, all Resonators in the team additionally gain <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=131111>Unison Boon</te></color> for {5}s. This effect does not stack.

While in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Electro Flare</color>:
While in combat, <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> DMG taken by targets within a certain range around Hsin can be Critical, with Crit. Rate fixed at {3} and Crit. DMG fixed at {4}.

skills.name: Moon Steps
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Moonring - Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks with the <color=Highlight>Moonring</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Moonring - Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target with <color=Highlight>Moonring</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack again shortly after performing this skill to cast Moonring - Basic Attack Stage 3.

<size=40><color=Title>Moonbow - Basic Attack</color></size>
Enter <color=Highlight><te href=141001>Lunar Cycle</te> - New Moon</color> by casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color>. When in this state, Iuno will attack with <color=Highlight>Moonbow</color>.
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks with the <color=Highlight>Moonbow</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Moonbow - Dodge Counter</color></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack shortly after a successful Dodge to attack the target with <color=Highlight>Moonbow</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
When in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack again shortly after performing this skill to cast Moonbow - Basic Attack Stage 3.
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Foresight Fugue
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Pulse of Origins</color></size>
Dash forward, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Closing Refrain</color></size>
When not in <color=Highlight><te href=141001>Lunar Cycle</te></color>, casting <color=Highlight>Moonring - Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, or <color=Highlight>Pulse of Origins</color> replaces Iuno's Resonance Skill with <color=Highlight>Closing Refrain</color> for 5s.
Casting Closing Refrain unleashes a flurry of strikes, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, and activates <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Unfinished Refrain</color></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color>, Iuno's Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Unfinished Refrain</color>.
Casting Unfinished Refrain unleashes a flurry of strikes, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Unfinished Refrain shares the same Cooldown as Closing Refrain.

<size=40><color=Title>Arc Beyond the Edge</color></size>
When Iuno is in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>, her Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Arc Beyond the Edge</color>, which has 2 initial charges.
Casting Arc Beyond the Edge causes Iuno to shift position and deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>, considered as Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Directional input can be used to extend the travel distance. If Iuno is hit or launched into mid-air, casting <color=Highlight>Arc Beyond the Edge</color> immediately makes her recover from the attack.
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Ebb and Flow
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle</color></size>
Iuno can activate Lunar Cycle by casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>.
Lunar Cycle has two states: <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color> and <color=Highlight>New Moon</color>. By default, Iuno enters the <color=Highlight>Half Moon</color> state when activating Lunar Cycle and can switch between the two states by casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux</color>.
When in Lunar Cycle:
- Iuno's Jump is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux</color>. STA won't recover when Iuno is in mid-air. 
- Iuno's movement becomes <color=Highlight>Meandering</color>, which consumes STA continuously in mid-air to move in a unique manner.
- Performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or holding Jump will end <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color></size>
Iuno attacks using the Moonring, restoring <color=Highlight><te href=141003>Sentience</te></color> on hit.
She can use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color>.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonbow</color> can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Lunar Cycle - New Moon</color></size>
Iuno attacks using the Moonbow. While in this state, casting <color=Highlight>Moonbow - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Arc Beyond the Edge</color>, or <color=Highlight>Moonbow - Dodge Counter</color> consumes <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> to increase the skill's DMG Multiplier, restore additional Concerto Energy, and heal nearby Resonators in the team.
Iuno can use <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color> to deal <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG) and switch to <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle - Half Moon</color>.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Flux: Moonring</color> can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Absolute Fullness</color></size>
When Iuno's Concerto Energy is full, her Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Absolute Fullness</color>.
Casting Absolute Fullness ends <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>, provides healing for nearby Resonators in the team, deals <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color> to nearby targets (considered as Resonance Liberation DMG), and conjures a <color=Highlight>Full Moon</color> domain at her location. This effect can be triggered once every 25s.
Can be cast in mid-air.

<size=40><color=Title>Full Moon Domain</color></size>
Resonators inside the domain periodically restore  HP and STA.
Gaining a Shield inside the domain grants 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Blessing of the Wan Light</color>. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

<size=40><color=Title>Blessing of the Wan Light</color></size>
The receiving Resonator gains 4% all DMG Amplification for 10s, stacking up to 10 times. Gaining new stacks resets the duration. This effect ends early if the receiving Resonator is switched off the field.

<size=40><color=Title>Sentience</color></size>
Iuno can hold up to 100 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
Casting Intro Skill restores 40 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation restores 60 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Closing Refrain</color> or <color=Highlight>Unfinished Refrain</color> restores 25 points of <color=Highlight>Sentience</color>.
When Iuno is in <color=Highlight>Lunar Cycle</color>, Moonring - Basic Attack, Moonring - Dodge Counter, and Mid-air Attack restore <color=Highlight>Sentience</color> on hit.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill while on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {15}</color>.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {18}</color>.

skills.name: Protocol Breach
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Payload</color></size>
Cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> to charge forward, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflicting <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color>. Upon hitting the target, a follow-up attack is automatically triggered, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and activating <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color>. If no target is hit during the charge, reduce the skill CD by {0}%. If the charge is interrupted or not successfully cast, the skill CD is not reduced.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after the follow-up attack to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {1}</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after follow-up attack lands to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack Stage {2}</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color></size>
Cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> to cut through the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and briefly Stagnating the target, before granting <color=Highlight>Digital Handshake</color>. 
<color=Highlight>Digital Handshake</color>: When Lucy is not in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> and is the active Resonator in the team, she gains <color=Highlight><te href=151103>TCP</te></color> every second. This effect is removed when <color=Highlight><te href=151103>TCP</te></color> reaches {3} points or when <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color> is cast.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {4}</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color></size>
When <color=Highlight><te href=151103>TCP</te></color> reaches {5} points or Lucy is in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> are replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>.
Cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflicting <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {6}</color>.
Reset the CD of <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color> after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>.

skills.name: Netrunner
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color></size>
Lucy deep dives into cyberspace and pulls up the Protocol Interface for {0}s. While the Protocol Interface is active, choose up to {1} different <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> effects, each requiring different RAM costs. Lucy starts with <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of RAM.
While in the Protocol Interface, Lucy marks targets within a certain range in her view. Marked targets will be applied with all <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> effects selected afterwards. Adjust Lucy's view to mark more targets. When no target is in view, no <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program</color> can be applied.
While in the Protocol Interface, when either the duration expires or when <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> is held down, <color=Highlight>Override</color> is triggered, which deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to all marked targets before closing the Protocol Interface, considered Heavy Attack DMG. When RAM runs out or is insufficient to activate any <color=Highlight>Spoofing Programs</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to trigger <color=Highlight>Override</color> on all marked targets. 
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
<size=10></size>
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Ping</color>
Requires {3} RAM. Extends field of view. Lucy marks and deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to all nearby targets within the effective range without having to adjust the view, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction</color>
Requires {4} RAM. Marked targets take {5}% more DMG for {6}s.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol</color>
Requires {7} RAM. Marked targets' DEF is reduced by {8}% for {9}s.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Synapse Burnout</color>
Requires {10} RAM. Deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to all marked targets within a certain range, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement</color>
Requires {11} RAM. Deals Hack DMG to all marked targets and reduces their ATK by {12}% for {13}s.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch</color>
Requires {14} RAM. Causes all marked targets' attacks to have a chance to be reduced by {15}% within {16}s.
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis</color>
Requires {17} RAM. Convert all marked targets to neutral units and reduce their Vibration Strength. Only effective against Common Class enemies.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color></size>
When in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color>, after <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color> is cast, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>. Lucy gains all effects of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color>, and the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Override</color> is greatly increased.
After casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>, or when Lucy exits the <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air close to the ground.
