skills.name: Ghost Cyberware
skills.descriptionTemplate:
When Lucy is the active Resonator in the team, if she takes no damage for {0}s, she gains <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color>. Max <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} by default.
<color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color>: When attacked, reduce this instance of DMG by {3}%. If Lucy is hit or launched from the attack, she immediately recovers and triggers a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> if she's on the ground. After this effect is triggered, remove <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=4} of <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color>. This effect can be triggered up to <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=6} every {5}s.

skills.name: Function Cracking
skills.descriptionTemplate:
When <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color> damages an <color=Highlight>Overlord Class</color> or <color=Highlight>Calamity Class</color> enemy, Lucy applies <color=Highlight>Botnet Mark</color> on them for {0} min. While <color=Highlight>Botnet Mark</color> is active, when a Resonator in the team defeats that target with direct damage, Lucy gains the <color=Highlight>Network Backdoor</color> effect. If Rebecca is in the team, she gains the same effect.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Network Backdoor</color></size>
Grants {1}% All DMG Amplification and {2}% additional Hack DMG Multiplier. This effect lasts for {3} min and stacks up to {4} times. At {5} stacks, additionally increases All DMG Amplification by {6}% and Hack DMG Multiplier by {7}%. When Lucy is downed, she can no longer gain <color=Highlight>Network Backdoor</color>, and any existing <color=Highlight>Network Backdoor</color> effects become invalid.

skills.name: Outdated Hallucination
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and granting Resonators in the team <color=Highlight>Involuntary Sharing</color>, allowing them to see targets behind obstacles for {0}s. Additionally, <color=Highlight>Involuntary Sharing</color> is enhanced on Rebecca, allowing her to lock onto targets behind obstacles. If Rebecca's turret is on the field, its Overload effect is activated, increasing its DMG dealt for {1}s.
If Lucy is not in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage {2}</color>.
If Lucy is in <color=Highlight><te href=151102>Algorithm Compaction</te></color> after casting this skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding Stage {3}</color>.
After casting this skill, the next <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> additionally grants {4} points of <color=Highlight><te href=151103>TCP</te></color>.

skills.name: Depths of Blackwall
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Cloud Portal</color></size>
When not in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, Lucy gains <color=Highlight>TCP</color> upon hitting a target. At {0} points of <color=Highlight>TCP</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> are replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color> clears all <color=Highlight>TCP</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Algorithm Compaction</color></size>
After casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color>, Lucy enters <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color> and gains <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight>SQL</color>. Her <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>. Lucy's <color=Light>Spectro DMG Bonus</color> is increased by {2}% for {3}s.
While in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Deadlock</color> again will not grant <color=Highlight>SQL</color> and Spectro DMG Bonus repetitively.
When in <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color>, Lucy gains <color=Highlight>Root Access</color> upon hitting a target with attacks including <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color> and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>. Reaching {4} points of <color=Highlight>Root Access</color> replaces <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color> with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>.
When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, if Lucy has <color=Highlight>SQL</color>, increase this attack's DMG Multiplier by {5}% and remove <color=Highlight>SQL</color>.
When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, if Lucy does not have <color=Highlight>SQL</color>, she loses {6}% of current HP. If Lucy's HP is below {7}%, no HP is consumed.
After casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>.
Lucy exits the the <color=Highlight>Algorithm Compaction</color> state after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>, or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color> is not followed up by one of these skills: <color=Highlight>Normal Attack - Locked Thread</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Protocol Breach</color>, <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination</color>, and <color=Highlight>Tune Break - Data Crash</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Hack Response - Data Crash</color></size>
Lucy deals <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to a target inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color> and applies the same target with <color=Highlight>Data Crash</color>, considered Hack DMG.
<color=Highlight>Data Crash</color>: After the target deals damage, Stagnate the target for {9}s. Data Crash is removed after this effect is triggered.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>TCP</color></size>
Lucy holds up to {10} points of <color=Highlight>TCP</color>.
Lucy gains <color=Highlight>TCP</color> when she deals damage through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>.
Lucy gains <color=Highlight>TCP</color> when she deals damage through <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color>.
After casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination</color>, casting the next <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color> additionally grants <SapTag=A>{11}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=A} of <color=Highlight>TCP</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Root Access</color></size>
Lucy holds up to {12} points of <color=Highlight>Root Access</color>.
Lucy gains <color=Highlight>Root Access</color> when she deals damage through <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Thread Shredding</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Single Threading</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Algorithm Compaction</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Algorithm Compaction</color>.

skills.name: Countermeasure Program
skills.descriptionTemplate:
The incoming Resonator gains {0}% Basic Attack DMG Amplification for {1}s or until they are switched out.
Grants all Resonators in the team <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> for {2}s.
While the effect is active, when an active Resonator in the team other than Lucy inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color>, that Resonator gains {3}% All DMG Amplification.
While the effect is active, when a Resonator in the team other than Lucy is attacked, Lucy grants them {5}% DMG Reduction for {4}s and Stagnates their attacker for {6}s. This effect can only trigger up to {7} time while <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> is active. Obtaining <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> again resets the effective charge. 
When the All DMG Amplification is effective, switching to another Resonator ends the <color=Highlight>Countermeasure Program</color> early.

skills.name: Data Crash
skills.descriptionTemplate:
When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Lucy can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.
Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color>: when Resonators in the team trigger <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target and cause them to be affected by <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color>, Lucy applies <color=Highlight>Hack Response - Data Crash</color> on the target. Each target can be inflicted with this effect up to <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=1} every {0}s.

chains.name: The Moon, a Ticket, and a Dream
chains.descriptionTemplate:
Lucy is now immune to interruptions during <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Payload</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Inteference</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Dual Threading</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-Threading</color>
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Outdated Hallucination</color> increases ATK by {0}% for {1}s.
When a Resonator in the team defeats a target affected by <color=Highlight><te href=151107>Spoofing Program</te></color> with direct damage, Lucy records the effect triggered and activates the corresponding <color=Highlight>Quick Action</color> on that Resonator for {2}s. The record expires when Lucy is knocked out.
<color=Highlight>Quick Action</color>: When activated, inflict the recorded <color=Highlight><te href=151107>Spoofing Program</te></color> effects on targets within a certain distance from the active Resonator in the team, effective once only on each target.
The following <color=Highlight><te href=151107>Spoofing Program</te></color> effects can be recorded: <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction</color>, <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol</color>, <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement</color>, <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch</color>, and <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis</color>. When applying <color=Highlight><te href=151107>Spoofing Program</te></color> effects via <color=Highlight>Quick Action</color>, only the continuous status effects are applied.

chains.name: The Blackwall, the Past, the Escape
chains.descriptionTemplate:
While casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color>, Lucy's starting <color=Highlight>RAM</color> is increased to {0}.
After casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Pulse Interference</color>, deal <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> additional {Cus:Sap,S=instance P=instances SapTag=1} of <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> equal to {2}% of Lucy's ATK, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
When this instance of damage hits the target, apply all of the following <color=Highlight><te href=151107>Spoofing Program</te></color> effects: <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberware Malfunction</color>, 
<color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Breach Protocol</color>, <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement</color>, <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Weapon Glitch</color>, and <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cyberpsychosis</color>. Only the continuous status effects are applied.
<color=Highlight>Forte Circuit - Depths of Blackwall</color> is enhanced: When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Multi-threading</color>, if Lucy has <color=Highlight><te href=151106>SQL</te></color>, the DMG Multiplier increase is raised from {3}% to {4}%.

chains.name: Cyberpunk
chains.descriptionTemplate:
The DMG Multiplier of Override from <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Netrunner</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Old Net Deep Dive</color> is increased by {0}%, and its Crit. DMG is increased by {1}%.
The DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Spoofing Program: Cripple Movement</color> is increased by {2}%.
The DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Hack Response - Data Crash</color> is increased by {3}%.

chains.name: No Living Legends in Night City
chains.descriptionTemplate: When Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color>, Resonators in the team gain {0}% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for {1}s.

chains.name: A Broken Path to Hell
chains.descriptionTemplate:
The stack limit of <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color> obtainable via <color=Highlight>Inherent Skill - Ghost Cyberware</color> is increased to {0}.
<color=Highlight>Inherent Skill - Ghost Cyberware</color> is now enhanced: When Lucy's HP falls below {1}%, she immediately gains <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color> upon being hit. This effect has a Cooldown of {3}s. When <color=Highlight>Optical Illusion</color> is triggered, Lucy gains a Shield equal to {4}% of ATK for {5}s.

chains.name: I Really Want to Stay At Your House
chains.descriptionTemplate:
Targets with <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color> or in the <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color> state take {0}% increased Heavy Attack DMG from Lucy.
Targets with <color=Highlight><te href=151101>Hack - Shifting</te></color> or in the <color=Highlight><te href=151104>Hack - Interfered</te></color> state take {1}% increased Hack DMG from Lucy.
The Stagnation triggered by <color=Highlight>Hack Response - Data Crash</color> now lasts for {2}s.

<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light: Sprint</color></size>

skills.name: Searchlight Service
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Pounce</color></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Yellow Light Mode</color>, use Resonance Skill to perform Pounce, which consumes STA to pounce on the target before switching to <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color>.
Lumi will perform a <color=Highlight>Pounce</color> without STA cost when switched onto the field.

<size=40><color=Title>Rebound</color></size>
When in <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color>, use Resonance Skill to perform Rebound, which consumes STA to leap backward and attack the target before switching to <color=Highlight>Yellow Light Mode</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light Mode</color></size>
Perform ranged attacks when in Yellow Light Mode.

<size=40><color=Title>Red Light Mode</color></size>
Perform melee attacks when in Red Light Mode.

skills.name: Signal Light
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Energized Pounce</color></size>
When Yellow Light Spark is fully recovered, replace Resonance Skill with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Energized Pounce</color> that deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color>. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG.
When in <color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color>, the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Red Light: Basic Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Red Light: Heavy Attack</color> is increased, with an extra amount of Sparks recovered.
<color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color> ends after performing altogether 4 Basic Attacks and/or Heavy Attacks.

<size=40><color=Title>Energized Rebound</color></size>
When Red Light Spark is fully recovered, replace Resonance Skill with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Energized Rebound</color> that deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> and enter <color=Highlight>Yellow Spotlight Mode</color>. The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG.
When in <color=Highlight>Yellow Spotlight Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Glitter</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Glare</color>, with an increased DMG Multiplier and an extra amount of Sparks recovered.
<color=Highlight>Yellow Spotlight Mode</color> ends after shooting 6 <color=Highlight>Glares</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Laser</color></size>
Casting Outro Skill consumes all Sparks obtained in the current mode.
Laser can be cast when the amount of consumed Sparks is greater than or equal to {0}, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.  The DMG dealt is considered Basic Attack DMG. 
Every {0} Sparks consumed generates {1} extra Laser beam, up to {2} Laser beams.

<size=40><color=Title>Yellow Light Spark</color></size>
Lumi can hold up to {3} Yellow Light Sparks.
Lumi obtains Yellow Light Spark under the following conditions: 
When <color=Highlight>Yellow Light: Basic Attack</color> hits the target;
When <color=Highlight>Glitter</color> hits the target;
When <color=Highlight>Glare</color> hits the target;
When Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Energized Rebound</color> hits the target;
When casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Special Delivery</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Red Light Spark</color></size>
Lumi can hold up to {3} Red Light Sparks.
Lumi obtains Red Light Spark under the following conditions:
When Normal Attack <color=Highlight>Navigation Support</color> hits the target in <color=Highlight>Red Light Mode</color> or <color=Highlight>Red Spotlight Mode</color>.

skills.name: Flaming Star
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
- After Basic Attack Stage 3, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack in the right time to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 1</color>.
- After <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Starfall</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Shewolf's Hunt</color>, or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack in time to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color></size>
When <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> reaches {0} points, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> will be replaced by <color=Highlight>Wolf's Gnawing</color>, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
- This attack does not restore <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. Consume {1} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> to perform this attack and gain <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=2} of <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>.

<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color></size>
When <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> reaches {3} points and <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {4} point, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> will be replaced by <color=Highlight>Wolf's Claw</color>, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
- If <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> reaches {5} points and <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {6} point after performing <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> in time to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>.
- This attack does not restore <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. Consume {7} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> to perform this attack and gain <SapTag=8>{8}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=8} of <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size> 
Consume STA to perform up to 3 attacks in mid-air, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. The <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> cycle will not be reset.

<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color></size>
When <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> reaches {9} points, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color> will be replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>, consuming STA to attack the target and dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Heavy Attack DMG).
- This attack does not restore <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. Consume {10} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> to perform this attack and gain <SapTag=11>{11}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=11} of <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>.

<size=40><color=Title>Plunging Attack</color></size>
Hold Normal Attack while airborne to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. After performing this attack, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack in time to perform Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Starfall</color>.
- If a <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> is performed while casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color> in time at the cost of STA.

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Starfall</color></size>
Attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

skills.name: Shewolf's Hunt
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Lupa hurls her Wildfire Banner at the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> and restoring {0} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. <color=Highlight>Mark</color> the target for {1}s. After performing Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Shewolf's Hunt</color>, Lupa can perform <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color> within a certain period of time.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.
- Hold Resonance Skill to leap into the air, then {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> in time to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 1</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Feral Fang</color></size>
Lupa locks onto a target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> and restoring {2} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. The DMG Multiplier to <color=Highlight>marked</color> targets is increased by {3}. Resonance Skill - Feral Fang enters cooldown if not cast in time or when Lupa is switched out.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

skills.name: Fire-Kissed Glory
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Attack the target and deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. Performing this attack consumes all <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> and restores {0} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te>. Use Basic Attack or Resonance Skill in time to cast Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Foebreaker</color>.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.
Performing this skill strengthens all Resonators in the team. Within {1}s:
- All Resonators in the team gain <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color> effect.
- If the active Resonator is hit or launched into the air, they immediately recover and are considered to have successfully dodged the attack when they are on the ground. Can be triggered up to 3 times.

<size=40><color=Title>Pack Hunt</color></size>
Resonators with <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color> gain a {2} ATK increase, and {3} Fusion DMG Bonus when they attack Overlord Class or Calamity Class targets (Both are non-stackable). If there are {7} Fusion Resonators in the team, the Fusion DMG Bonus against Overlord Class or Calamity Class targets additionally increases by {8}. When the active Resonator casts <color=Highlight>Intro Skill</color>, <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color> is enhanced, granting an additional {4} ATK increase to all Resonators in the team, up to a maximum of {5}.
If Lupa's <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color> reaches its cap within its duration, she enters <color=Highlight>Wild Hunt</color> and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Nowhere to Run!</color> becomes available. <color=Highlight>Wild Hunt</color> can be triggered once per <color=Highlight>Pack Hunt</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Foebreaker</color></size>
Consume all <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> to perform <color=Highlight>Foebreaker</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> and entering <color=Highlight>Burning Matchpoint</color> state. 

<size=40><color=Title>Burning Matchpoint</color></size>
Normal Attacks restore {6} more <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> on hit. Cannot perform Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Shewolf's Hunt</color> and Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color> in this state.

skills.name: Remember My Name
skills.descriptionTemplate:
After dashing for {0}s, Lupa enters Sprint state. The next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Starfall</color>.
Gain increased resistance to interruptions while casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>, and <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>.

skills.name: Applause of Victory
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Defeating a <color=Highlight>marked</color> target resets the cooldown of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Shewolf's Hunt</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Liberation - Glory</color></size>
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fire-Kissed Glory</color> grants <color=Highlight>Glory</color>. Within {0}s:
Attacks of all Resonators in the team ignore {1} of the target's Fusion RES. For each Fusion Resonator in the team other than Lupa, this effect increases by {2}, up to the maximum of {3}. When there are {4} Fusion Resonators in the team, Resonators' attacks further ignore {5} Fusion RES.

skills.name: Try Focusing, Eh?
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> following Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Try Focusing, Eh?</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Nowhere to Run!</color></size>
When Lupa enters the <color=Highlight>Wild Hunt</color> state, her next Intro Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Nowhere to Run!</color>. Casting <color=Highlight>Nowhere to Run!</color> removes the <color=Highlight><te href=850176>Pack Hunt</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=850178>Glory</te></color> effects on all Resonators in the team, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Liberation DMG).

skills.name: Ignis Lupa
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Wildfire Banner</color></size>
Lupa's ATK is increased by {0} for {1}s when performing the following actions:
- Casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color>.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>, or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>.
- Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fire-Kissed Glory</color>.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> and <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf</color></size>
When <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {2} points, Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color>. Performing <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> consumes all <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Liberation DMG).
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color></size>
When <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te> reaches {3} points in the <color=Highlight><te href=850177>Burning Matchpoint</te></color> state, Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>. Performing <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color> consumes all <te href=850175>Wolfaith</te>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Liberation DMG). <color=Highlight>Burning Matchpoint</color> is removed when the skill ends.
Can be performed in mid-air close to the ground.

<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Set the Arena Ablaze</color></size>
Within {4}s after performing <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> or <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>, Lupa will remain on the field after switching to another Resonator and back up the active Resonator when they perform <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> (considered Resonance Skill DMG). This effect can only be triggered once in its duration.

<size=40><color=Title>Wolflame</color></size>
Lupa can hold up to {5} points of Wolflame.
- Restore Wolflame when Normal Attacks hit the target.
- Restore Wolflame while casting Resonance Skill.
- Restore Wolflame while casting Resonance Liberation.

<size=40><color=Title>Wolfaith</color></size>
Lupa can hold up to {6} points of Wolfaith.
Wolfaith lasts for {7}s. The duration is reset when Wolfaith is restored. At the end of its duration, each remaining point of Wolfaith becomes {8} points of Wolflame.
- Restore {9} point of Wolfaith when casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Gnawing</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Wolf's Claw</color>, or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Firestrike</color>.

chains.descriptionTemplate:
The DMG Multiplier of Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Nowhere to Run!</color> increases by {0}.
- The <color=Highlight><te href=850176>Pack Hunt</te></color> effect of Resonance Liberation now no longer requires {3} Fusion Resonators.

Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fire-Kissed Glory</color> additionally grants <color=Highlight><te href=850178>Glory</te></color>: Resonators in the team ignore {2} Fusion RES of targets for {1}s.

chains.name: High and Aflame Is Her Banner
chains.descriptionTemplate: The DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color> increases by {0}.

chains.descriptionTemplate: Performing Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Try Focusing, Eh?</color> or <color=Highlight>Nowhere to Run!</color> gives {0} Resonance Liberation DMG Bonus for {1}s.

chains.name: To the Brightest Flaming Star
chains.descriptionTemplate:
- The damage dealt by Forte Circuit <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Fire-Kissed Glory</color>, and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Nowhere to Run!</color> ignores {0} of the target's DEF.
- Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Feral Fang</color> restores {1} points of <te href=850174>Wolflame</te> on hit, triggered once per {2}s.
- Forte Circuit <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color>. <color=Highlight>Dance With the Wolf: Climax</color> can be performed when Lupa is not in <color=Highlight><te href=850177>Burning Matchpoint</te></color> state.
- Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Nowhere to Run!</color> no longer ends <color=Highlight><te href=850176>Pack Hunt</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=850178>Glory</te></color>.

skills.name: Such is Light
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Hurl out a whirling blade on Stage 3, which disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that can deal damage or leaves the field.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to jump into the air, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks in mid-air, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Stage 4 is a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.
<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> Stage {0} and 3 in mid-air.
Luuk Herssen attacks with <color=Highlight>Scythe: Dissection</color> when the input is <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>.
Luuk Herssen attacks with <color=Highlight>Scythe: Resection</color> when the input is <color=Highlight>Jump</color>. He also inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target hit for {1}s and reduces DMG taken by {3} for {2}s.
As the active Resonator, while in mid-air, this skill's cycle will not be reset.
While in mid-air, <color=Highlight>hold Normal Attack</color> to perform a Plunging Attack at the cost of STA.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> right after a successful Dodge on the ground to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> right after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.
<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> right after a successful Dodge in mid-air to flash toward the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

skills.name: Reunion of All the Fallen
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Golden Reflux</color></size>
Flash toward the target and deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target hit for 25s.
<color=Highlight>Golden Reflux</color> has 2 charges.
Can be cast in mid-air.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Aureole of Execution</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 4</color> or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 3</color> replaces <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> with <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color>, which deals Basic Attack DMG and inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target hit for 25s.
<color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> has {0} forms, including <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Ring</color>, <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Breach</color>, and <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color>.
Casting any form of <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> grants <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=151001>Endnotes on the Endgame</te></color> and switches <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> to the next form in sequence.
Switching to another Resonator resets the cycle of <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is reset to <color=Highlight>Golden Reflux</color>.
Can be cast in mid-air.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Aureole of Execution: Ring</color></size>
Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, and reset the <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> cycle to Stage 1.
The next <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> triggers <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color>.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color> is no longer available if <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is cast in mid-air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Aureole of Execution: Breach</color></size>
Spin and dash forward, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> to enemies along the path and resetting the <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> cycle to Stage 1. Then, hurl out an <color=Highlight><te href=151004>Ichor Blade</te></color>.
The next <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> triggers <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color>.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color> is no longer available if <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is cast in air or Luuk Herssen is switched out in the duration.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color></size>
Hurl out Solid-State Ichor, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and forming an <color=Highlight>Ichor Deposit</color> on the ground.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color></size>
Flash toward the target and deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Ichor Deposit</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Ichor Deposit</color> detonates automatically after {3}s, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Endnotes on the Endgame</color></size>
Increase the DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Rewritten in Winter's Margins</color> by {4}, stacking up to {2} times. Casting <color=Highlight>Rewritten in Winter's Margins</color> or switching to another Resonator removes all stacks.

skills.name: Rewritten in Winter's Margins
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Can be cast in mid-air.

skills.name: Pulses Under the Snow
skills.descriptionTemplate:
When Resonators in the team directly damage and defeat targets, if the targets are affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>:
- If Luuk Herssen has no Perpetuating Daytime, gain stacks of Perpetuating Daytime equal to the stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>.
- If Luuk Herssen already has Perpetuating Daytime, and the target's stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> exceed the current stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, increase Perpetuating Daytime's stacks to match the target's <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> stacks.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Perpetuating Daytime</color></size>
- When Resonators in the team casts <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color>, if the target is affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color>,  Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime, then apply equal stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target, up to the target's current <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> stack cap. Cooldown: {1}s.
Luuk Herssen loses all stacks of Perpetuating Daytime and will not be able to obtain any new stacks when knocked out.
- Perpetuating Daytime stacks up to {0} times.

skills.name: Uncaused Diagnosis
skills.descriptionTemplate:
When Luuk Herssen's skills directly damage targets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>, every {0} points of <color=Highlight>Tune Break Boost</color> he has Amplifies this instance of damage by {1}, up to {2}.
After any nearby Resonator in the team inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the enemies or deals <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> DMG, Luuk Herssen's ATK increases by {3} for {4}s.

skills.name: Before Injection of Dawn
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Hurl out an <color=Highlight><te href=151004>Ichor Blade</te></color> and inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on the target.
<color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack</color> after this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 2 - Scythe: Dissection</color> or <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack Stage 2 - Scythe: Resection</color>.

skills.name: Spark from the Frost
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color></size>
When the Solid-State Ichor of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color> is hurled out, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack</color> in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color>.
Slam down from the air to detonate the <color=Highlight><te href=151005>Ichor Deposit</te></color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> (considered Basic Attack DMG) and recovering all STA.
<color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color> is no longer available when Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Rewritten in Winter's Margins</color> is cast or Luuk Herssen is switched off the field.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Aureate Judge</color></size>
With full <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te>, enter the <color=Highlight>Aureate Judge</color> state. In this state, Luuk Herssen gains the following effects:
- <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te> does not restore. The DMG Multipliers of all forms of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> increase by {15}.
- Casting <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color> increases the DMG Multiplier of the next <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color> and <color=Highlight><te href=151005>Ichor Deposit</te></color> DMG by {15}.
- {1} points of <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te> is consumed each time Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> is cast.
- <color=Highlight>Aureate Judge</color> ends when <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te> depletes.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Golden Rule</color></size>
When Luuk Herssen is in the team, all other Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule. When Resonators with Golden Rule cast Outro Skill and the incoming Resonator is Luuk Herssen, remove all Golden Rules on Resonators in the team and grant Luuk Herssen {3} points of <te href=151002>Ichor Flow</te> and {4} points of Concerto Energy. Resonators in the team gain Golden Rule again after {2}s. This effect does not apply in Co-op Mode.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dawnlit Keep</color></size>
Luuk Herssen gains <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of Dawnlit Keep when he stays out of combat for over {5}s or casts Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Before Injection of Dawn</color>.
Dawnlit Keep is capped at {7} stack. When taking damage from enemies, consume <SapTag=9>{9}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=9} of Dawnlit Keep to reduce the DMG taken by {14} and gain immunity to interruptions for {10}s. This effect can be triggered once per second.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Radiant Reave</color></size>
When Luuk Herssen performs Dodge in mid-air, he briefly stays airborne and hurls out an <color=Highlight><te href=151004>Ichor Blade</te></color>.
Luuk Herssen consumes STA continuously while airborne.
If Luuk Herssen is launched into mid-air, <color=Highlight>{Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Dodge</color> before landing to trigger this effect, up to 3 times. When he is on the ground or switched out for more than {12}s, the trigger count is reset.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Ichor Blade</color></size>
Deal fixed <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG that is not affected by any DMG Bonus.
Only one <color=Highlight>Ichor Blade</color> can exist at a time. It cannot trigger <color=Highlight>Counterattack</color>.
<color=Highlight>Ichor Blade</color> cannot be launched without a nearby target.
<color=Highlight>Ichor Blade</color> disappears when Luuk Herssen casts other skills that deal damage or leaves the field.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Ichor Flow</color></size>
Luuk Herssen holds up to {0} points of Ichor Flow.
Normal Attacks, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Golden Reflux</color>, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Golden Impale</color>, and <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color> restore Ichor Flow on hit.
Casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Before Injection of Dawn</color> restores {13} points of Ichor Flow.

Luuk Herssen can inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on targets.
Luuk Herssen can respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>.
When responding to <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>: For each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target, each point of Luuk Herssen's Tune Break Boost increases his total DMG against the target by {1}. While Luuk Herssen is in the team, the max stack limit of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on a target is increased by {2}.
When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Luuk Herssen can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

chains.name: Gold Kindled in Ash
chains.descriptionTemplate:
Luuk Herssen gains {0} <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> DMG Bonus.
The max stack limit of <te href=151003>Dawnlit Keep</te> is increased by {1}.
When in the <color=Highlight>Aureate Judge</color> state, casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> grants <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <te href=151003>Dawnlit Keep</te>.

chains.name: Avalanche Roaring in Eyes
chains.descriptionTemplate:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Rewritten in Winter's Margins</color> is increased by {0}. This DMG Multiplier increase effect is stackable with that of <te href=151001>Endnotes on the Endgame</te>.

When Luuk Herssen deals damage to targets inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>, every {1} points of Tune Break Boost he has now Amplify this instance of damage by {2}. This effect now increases the DMG Amplification up to {4} instead of {3}.

chains.descriptionTemplate:
The DMG Multipliers of all forms of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color> are increased by {0} in the <color=Highlight>Aureate Judge</color> state. Casting <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution: Glare</color> increases the DMG Multipliers of the next <color=Highlight>Mid-Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color> and <color=Highlight><te href=151005>Ichor Deposit</te></color> by {0}.
Inherent Skill <color=Highlight>Pulses Under the Snow</color> is enhanced:
Perpetuating Daytime now stacks up to {2} times.

chains.name: Pulse Thrumming Under Rime
chains.descriptionTemplate: After a Resonator in the team deals <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> DMG, all Resonators in the team deal {0} more DMG for {1}s. This effect is unstackable.

chains.name: Through the Stillness of Snowstorm
chains.descriptionTemplate:
Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Before Injection of Dawn</color> and Outro Skill <color=Highlight>Bow to the Last Light</color> gain {0} DMG Bonus.
Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Golden Reflux</color> has its DMG Multiplier increased by {1} and Cooldown reduced by {2}s, and gains 1 more charge.

chains.name: Dawn Unfurling over Frostlands
chains.descriptionTemplate:
When nearby Resonators in the team deal <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> DMG, all forms of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Aureole of Execution</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=151005>Ichor Deposit</te></color>, and <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Gavel of Earthshaker</color> deal {0} more DMG to the target for {1}s.
Each stack of <te href=151001>Endnotes on the Endgame</te> additionally grants Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Rewritten in Winter's Margins</color> {2} DMG Bonus, up to {3}.
When Luuk Herssen deals damage to targets inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>, the stack count of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target is increased by {4}. This effect ignores the max stack limit.

skills.name: Chroma Drift
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack to perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color></size>
With full <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> in the <color=Highlight><te href=150901>Optical Sampling Stage</te></color>, hold Normal Attack to enter a charging state.
During this state, 15 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> will be converted to 12.5% of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> every 0.2s. Lynae is immune to interruption and takes {0} less DMG.
Upon releasing Normal Attack or when <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> is full, Lynae casts Spark Collision of varying strengths based on the ratio of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>:
- Spark Collision Lv. 1: <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> <50%
- Spark Collision Lv. 2: 50% ≤ <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> < 100%
- Spark Collision Lv. 3: <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>=100%
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack</color>.
Perform up to 5 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
With 120 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 1 & 4</color> track enemies in a greater distance.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, hold Normal Attack on the ground to cast this skill. Consume STA to continuously attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG. Release to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Graffiti Blast</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, hold Normal Attack in mid-air to cast this skill. Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Basic Attack DMG.
Cannot gain new charges while in the air. The available charges reset when Lynae is the active Resonator and is on the ground.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Attack</color>.
Consume STA to perform Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Lynae-Style Palettes</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Skill to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. 
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, hold Resonance Skill to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and exiting the <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>. 
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time after this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
Lynae-Style Palettes and Additive Color <color=Highlight>share a cooldown</color>.
<size=10></size>

During <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Skill on the ground to attack the target, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
Within a certain time during the skill, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
Lynae-Style Palettes and Additive Color <color=Highlight>share a cooldown</color>.

skills.name: Prismatic Overblast
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Casting this skill increases the DMG dealt by all nearby Resonators in the team by {0} for {1}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Prismatic Overblast</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack within a certain time during the skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.

After casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color>, Lynae leaves <color=Highlight><te href=150904>Spray Paint</te></color> on the ground and continuously inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets within the <color=Highlight><te href=150904>Spray Paint</te></color> for {1}s, triggered once every {0}s. When <color=Highlight><te href=150904>Spray Paint</te></color> is on the ground, switching to another <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode</color> doesn't affect the <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> effects inflicted by the <color=Highlight><te href=150904>Spray Paint</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
With Lynae in the team, the expedition motorbike's Energy Tank expands by 600 points. Lynae enters <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> automatically while on the expedition motorbike and restores 20% of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> per second.

skills.name: "Adaptive Optics: Everyday Applications"
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors!</color> increases Lynae's <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> Bonus by {1} for {0}s. 
<size=10></size>
During <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, if Lynae isn't in combat, dodging without directional input grants her <color=Highlight>Optic Camo</color> for {2}s, which will be removed when Lynae casts any skill other than dodging or is switched off the field. Performing environmental, gameplay or functional interactions, or entering combat, removes the <color=Highlight>Optic Camo</color>. With <color=Highlight>Optic Camo</color>, Lynae may enter the enemy's aggro range without triggering combat.

skills.name: Time to Show Some Colors!
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, inflicting <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150901>Optical Sampling Stage</te></color>, casting this skill recovers {0} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color>.

values.name: Time to Show Some Colors! DMG

skills.name: Chromaticity Modeling
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Optical Sampling Stage</color></size>
Lynae is in <color=Highlight><te href=150901>Optical Sampling Stage</te></color> by default. While in this state, <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> recovers during certain skills.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Kaleidoscopic Parade</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> sends Lynae into <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>. In this state, Lynae continuously recovers <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> while moving on the ground or during certain periods of certain skills. Lynae will not Walk during this state, and her Running and Sprinting will be replaced by the faster <color=Highlight>Free Skating</color> and <color=Highlight>Speed Skating</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, with at least 1/3 of the max <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, Jump is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color>.
Consume 1/3 of the max <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. Inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit. Successful Dodges can be triggered within a certain time during this skill. While airborne, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> chains up to 3 stages. Switching to another Resonator resets the combo.
While in combat, each stage of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> cast recovers 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.
Within a certain time after <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 1</color> {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack on the ground to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap Stage 2</color> also pulls in nearby targets.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color></size>
During <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> is on cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color></size>
During <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, when Lynae is in mid-air with 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, and this skill is not on cooldown, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Normal Attack or Resonance Skill to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> on targets hit.
This skill consumes 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color> and grants all nearby Resonators in the team {0} points of Tune Break Boost for {1}s.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack within a certain time during this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack Stage 2</color>. 
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Mode</color></size>
Inflict <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> when hitting a target with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Time to Show Some Colors!</color>.
Lynae can switch between <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color> and <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>:
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Rupture</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> on targets for 25s.
- When in <color=Highlight>Resonance Mode - Tune Strain</color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150903>Photochromic Flux</te></color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on targets for 25s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis</color></size>
Deal an instance of <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, considered Tune Rupture DMG, to targets within range affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Overflow</color></size>
Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Overflow.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=150901>Optical Sampling Stage</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> recovers during Basic Attack, Lynae-Style Palettes, Mid-air Attack, and Dodge Counter, or when Intro Skill is cast.
When <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> is full, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> becomes available.
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Spark Collision</color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lumiflow</color></size>
Lynae can hold up to 120 points of Lumiflow.
During <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>:
- Restore 20% of <color=Highlight>Lumiflow</color> per second when Lynae is moving on the ground/climbing, or performs a successful Dodge on the ground, or within a certain time during <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Ground Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Dodge Counter</color>, <color=Highlight>Additive Color</color>, ground Dodge, Intro Skill, or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - To a Vivid Tomorrow!</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Lumiflow</color> starts to deplete by 20% per second while Lynae is staying still on the ground/climbing/swimming or off the field, or after a certain time following the use of the skills listed above.
- <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> does not change while Lynae is not in any of the states described above.
Exiting <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>.
With 120 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, Lynae's roller skating speed further increases. <color=Highlight>Speed Skating</color> consumes STA over time.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>True Color</color></size>
Lynae can hold up to 3 points of True Color.
During combat, each time <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> is cast, gain 1 point of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>. With 3 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color> and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> become available.
Exiting <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> removes all <color=Highlight><te href=150907>True Color</te></color>.

skills.descriptionTemplate:
Attack the target and deal {0} <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>. The next incoming Resonator gain {1} All DMG Amplification and {2} Resonance Liberation DMG Amplification for 14s or until they are switched out.
Lynae leaves the <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> state upon casting Outro Skill.

skills.name: Spectral Analysis
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Lynae can inflict <color=Highlight><te href=100002>Tune Rupture - Shifting</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=100003>Tune Strain - Shifting</te></color> on targets.
Lynae can respond to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>.
- Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color>: When any Resonator in the team deals <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> DMG and inflicts the <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> state, Lynae casts <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture Response - Spectral Analysis</color>. Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.
- Responding to <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color>: For each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on the target, each point of Lynae's Tune Break Boost increases her total DMG against that target by {1}. When Lynae is in the team, the target's max stack limit of <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> is increased by 1.
When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, Lynae can cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

chains.name: Days to be Painted Like a Canvas
chains.descriptionTemplate:
The DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> is increased by {0}.
The duration of <color=Highlight><te href=150904>Spray Paint</te></color> is increased by {1}. Targets within the range of <color=Highlight><te href=150904>Spray Paint</te></color> are <color=Highlight>pulled in</color> towards the center every {2}s.
Lynae is now immune to interruptions during <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color>.
During <color=Highlight><te href=150901>Optical Sampling Stage</te></color>, after staying in a non-combat state for {3}s, restore {4} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150905>Overflow</te></color> every {3}s.

Gain {0} All DMG Amplification.
Outro Skill gains the following effect:
Casting Outro Skill now additionally grants the incoming Resonator {1} All DMG Amplification for {2}s or until the Resonator is switched out.

chains.name: For One Brilliant Moment
chains.descriptionTemplate:
The DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color> is increased by {4}.
While Lynae is in combat, when <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> is at least 120 points, gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Premixed Hue</color> every {0}s, up to {1} stacks. Each stack of <color=Highlight>Premixed Hue</color> increases the Spectro DMG Bonus of <color=Highlight>Additive Color</color> by {2}. No <color=Highlight>Premixed Hue</color> is gained while casting <color=Highlight>Additive Color</color>. When <color=Highlight>Additive Color</color> ends, remove all stacks of <color=Highlight>Premixed Hue</color>. Lynae loses a stack of <color=Highlight>Premixed Hue</color> every {3}s when <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> is below 120 points.
While Lynae is out of combat, with at least 120 points of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>, gain 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Premixed Hue</color> every 0.5s; when <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> is below 120 points, lose 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Premixed Hue</color> every 1s.

chains.name: Shadows of a Wind Racer
chains.descriptionTemplate: ATK is increased by {0}.

chains.name: Visions of a Future Unbound
chains.descriptionTemplate: The DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Prismatic Overblast</color> is increased by {0}.

chains.name: Painted in My True Color
chains.descriptionTemplate:
Each time <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Graffiti Blast</color> or <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack</color> is cast, Lynae gains 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Color of Soul</color>, up to {2} stacks. Each stack of <color=Highlight>Color of Soul</color> increases the DMG the target takes from <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color> and <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color> by {3}. After casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Iridescent Splash</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Visual Impact</color>, all stacks of <color=Highlight>Color of Soul</color> are removed.
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Polychrome Leap</color> resets the charges of <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack</color>.
Lynae is immune to interruptions, and DMG taken is reduced by {5} during <color=Highlight>Kaleidoscopic Parade - Mid-air Heavy Attack</color>.
Lynae now stays in <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color> after casting <color=Highlight>Outro Skill - Let's Hit the Road!</color>.
The <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color> upper limit is increased from {0} to {1}. At the max limit, Lynae's roller skating speed further increases.
If Intro Skill is cast during <color=Highlight><te href=150902>Kaleidoscopic Parade</te></color>, restore {4} points of <color=Highlight><te href=150906>Lumiflow</te></color>.

skills.name: Ground State Calibration
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>.
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. 
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time afterward to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after performing this attack to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> right after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to counterattack and deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
Within a certain time afterward, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 3</color>.
