skills.name: Resolution
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Expectation Error</color></size>
Heal all nearby Resonators in the team and enter the Parry state, during which DMG taken is reduced by 100% for a time. Switching to another Resonator ends this state immediately.
If attacked while in the Parry state, exit the state and cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution</color>.
If not attacked while in the Parry state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to exit the state and cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Optimal Solution</color></size>
Stagnate nearby targets and deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, reducing the cooldown of <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Expectation Error</color> by {0}s.
Switching to another Resonator ends the Stagnation effect early.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Distributed Array</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>, Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color>.
Heal all nearby Resonators in the team and summon Hover Cannons to strike the target, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.

skills.name: Critical Protocol
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Attack the targets within the effective range, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
For every {1} of Mornye's Energy Regen exceeding {0}, this skill gains an additional {2} Crit. Rate (up to {3}) and {4} Crit. DMG (up to {5}).
When casting this skill, if a <color=Highlight><te href=120907>Syntony Field</te></color> is present, remove it and generate a <color=Highlight><te href=120908>High Syntony Field</te></color>.
Can be performed in mid-air.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>High Syntony Field</color></size>
- <color=Highlight>High Syntony Field</color> lasts for {6}s. 
- Increases the DEF of all nearby Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>High Syntony Field</color> by {8}.
- Inherits the <color=Highlight><te href=120907>Syntony Field</te></color>'s boost to resistance to interruption and <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Buildup Rate</color>.
- Inherits the <color=Highlight><te href=120907>Syntony Field</te></color>'s healing effect and increases the Healing Multiplier by {7}.

skills.name: Blueprint
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Mornye's Energy Regen is increased by {4}.
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Convergence</color> restores {0} points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every {1}s.
Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 3</color> restores {2} points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every {3}s.

skills.name: Boundedness
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Expectation Error</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color> grants <color=Highlight>Proof of Boundedness</color> to all Resonators in the team:
- <color=Highlight>Proof of Boundedness</color> lasts for {0}s and can be gained once every {1} min.
- When the active Resonator takes DMG greater than {2} of their Max HP, they instead take DMG equal to {3} of their Max HP. This effect can trigger up to <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=4}. <color=Highlight>Proof of Boundedness</color> is removed after triggering it <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=5}.
- When the active Resonator takes a fatal blow, they are not downed by this instance of damage. This effect can trigger up to <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=6}. <color=Highlight>Proof of Boundedness</color> is removed after triggering it <SapTag=7>{7}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=7}.
- When <color=Highlight>Proof of Boundedness</color> is removed, the active Resonator restores HP equal to {8} of Mornye's DEF.

skills.name: Convergence
skills.descriptionTemplate: Attack the target to deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, then jump into mid-air, clearing all <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color> and entering <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>.

skills.name: Mass-Energy Equivalence
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Baseline Mode</color></size>
While in her default <color=Highlight>Baseline Mode</color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift</color></size>
When <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color> reaches {0} points, Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift</color>.
Cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift</color> to deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Afterward, Mornye jumps into mid-air, consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=120903>Rest Mass Energy</te></color> and enters <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Wide Field Observation Mode</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> lasts for {11}s.
- Upon entering <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye generates a <color=Highlight><te href=120907>Syntony Field</te></color>.
- While in <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color>.
- If <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> is below {0} when holding <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color>, perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 1 to 3</color> in sequence. If <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> reaches {0} during this time, cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> instead.
- While moving, Mornye continuously consumes STA. STA cannot be recovered while in <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>.
- When <color=Highlight>Dodging</color> with directional input, Mornye starts to fly at speed, which lasts for up to 10s or until STA is depleted or until the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> ends.
- When Mornye is hit or launched into mid-air, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to immediately recover from the attack, which is considered a successful Dodge. This effect can be triggered up to {12} times, which resets when <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> ends.
- {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump and Mornye will slowly descend. Before she lands, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> are unavailable. If Jump is {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tapped PC=pressed Gamepad=pressed} when Mornye runs out of STA, she will exit the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. She will leave the <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color> also when she <color=Highlight>Dodges</color>, Jumps, or performs Mid-air Attacks.
Additionally, performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or switching to another Resonator ends <color=Highlight>Wide Field Observation Mode</color>. The state also ends when Mornye is no longer airborne.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Syntony Field</color></size>
- <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color> lasts for {1}s.
- When the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color> is generated, deal <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Continuously restores HP for nearby active Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color>, triggered once every {2}s.
- Increases the <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Buildup Rate</color> of all nearby Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color> by {3}.
- Enhances the resistance to interruption of nearby active Resonators in the team within the <color=Highlight>Syntony Field</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color></size>
- When <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> reaches {0} points, Heavy Attack is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color>.
- Consume all <color=Highlight><te href=120904>Relative Momentum</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color>, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
- <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=120905>Observation Marker</te></color> upon the target on hit for {4}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Observation Marker</color></size>
When a Resonator in the team deals <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> DMG to a target inflicted with <color=Highlight>Observation Marker</color>, Mornye inflicts an <color=Highlight><te href=120906>Interfered Marker</te></color> on the target for {5}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Interfered Marker</color></size>
Targets affected by <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> take increased DMG from all nearby Resonators in the team. For every {8} of Mornye's Energy Regen exceeding {7}, their DMG is increased by {9}, up to {10}.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Visual Field</color></size>
When a Resonator in the team defeats a target inflicted with <color=Highlight><te href=120905>Observation Marker</te></color> or <color=Highlight><te href=120906>Interfered Marker</te></color>, Mornye gains <color=Highlight>Visual Field</color> for {6}s. While in this state, Mornye inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=120905>Observation Marker</te></color> on the target hit whenever any Resonator in the team deals damage.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet</color></size>
Mornye deals one instance of <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color> to targets in the <color=Highlight><te href=100004>Tune Rupture - Interfered</te></color> state within range, considered <color=Highlight>Tune Rupture DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Rest Mass Energy</color></size>
Mornye can hold up to {0} points of <color=Highlight>Rest Mass Energy</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120901>Baseline Mode</te></color>, she gains <color=Highlight>Rest Mass Energy</color> when performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color>, or when <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution</color> hits a target.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Relative Momentum</color></size>
Mornye can hold up to {0} points of <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color>.
While in <color=Highlight><te href=120902>Wide Field Observation Mode</te></color>, she gains <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color> when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Distributed Array</color> hits the target.
Mornye cannot gain <color=Highlight>Relative Momentum</color> during <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Inversion</color>.

skills.name: Impromptu Show
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Mortefi uses his dual pistols and flames to perform up to 4 consecutive shots, dealing <color=Fire>Fusion DMG</color>.
<size=10> </size>

<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
When performing <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, enter <color=Highlight><te href=160805>Reincarnate</te></color> state.
<size=10></size>

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 2</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Scarlet Coda</color></size>
Phrolova enters the <color=Highlight>Compose</color> state every {1}s.
When the following 3 conditions are met, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Scarlet Coda</color>.
- Has 6 <color=Highlight><te href=160801>Volatile Notes</te></color>.
- In the <color=Highlight>Compose</color> state.
- Not in the <color=Highlight><te href=160802>Resolving Chord</te></color> state.
<size=10></size>
<color=Highlight>Scarlet Coda</color>: Consume STA to deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, Stagnating and pulling in nearby targets. This instance of damage is considered <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill DMG</color>.
Each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=160803>Aftersound</te></color> additionally increases the DMG Multiplier of this instance of damage.
Casting this skill is considered as casting <color=Highlight>Echo Skill</color>.
Casting this skill sends <color=Highlight>Compose</color> state into cooldown and activates the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform a Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> shortly after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.

skills.name: Waltz of Forsaken Depths
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color></size>
Phrolova's max Resonance Energy is 0. <color=Highlight>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color> does not consume Resonance Energy.
When in the <color=Highlight><te href=160802>Resolving Chord</te></color> state, <color=Highlight>Waltz of Forsaken Depths</color> becomes available.
Casting this skill ends the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, and Phrolova enters the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state for {0}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Maestro</color></size>
Gain {5} ATK increase.
Phrolova floats in the air and commands Hecate to fight. Hecate will share Phrolova's stats and statuses, and damage dealt by Hecate will be considered coming from Phrolova. Hecate's attacks will not remove the target's Hazy Dream state.
During this period, Phrolova plays the <color=Highlight><te href=160801>Volatile Notes</te></color> in turn. Each <color=Highlight>Volatile Note</color> holds for {1}s.
If Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, she can give the following cues to Hecate. Any damage taken by Hecate in this state affects Phrolova as well.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Basic Attack</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Normal Attack to command Hecate to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>. When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, for every {2} times Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color>, the next <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Dodge</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Dodge to command Hecate to dodge an attack. Hecate takes no damage from a hit successfully Dodged.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Reset</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Jump to reset Hecate's position.
- <color=Highlight>Cue - Curtain Call</color>: {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} Resonance Liberation to command Hecate to cast <color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> and end the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.
When Phrolova is not the active Resonator, Hecate takes no damage and automatically casts <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Hecate</color> to attack the target. When Resonators in the team cast Echo Skill, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color> to attack the target. This effect can be triggered up to {4} times in total during Phrolova's <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state. Echoes of the same name can trigger this effect <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=3}.
Switching back to Phrolova ends <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.
Ending <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state removes all <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Hecate</color></size>
Perform up to 2 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings</color></size>
When Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Strings</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Strings</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and Stagnating the targets (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color></size>
When Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Winds</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Winds</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, pulling the targets in (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza</color></size>
When Phrolova plays <color=Highlight>Volatile Note - Cadenza</color>, Hecate casts <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate: Cadenza</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Enhanced Attack - Hecate</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, Stagnating and pulling the targets in (considered <color=Highlight>Echo Skill DMG</color>).
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Curtain Call</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> can be cast via the following 5 ways, Stagnating the targets and dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>.
- When Phrolova is the active Resonator on the field, end the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state.
- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is not the active Resonator and the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state ends, switch to Phrolova without casting Intro Skill.
- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Maestro</color> state, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} Resonance Liberation.
- When Phrolova is in the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, hold Resonance Liberation.
When in <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state, casting <color=Highlight>Curtain Call</color> removes all <color=Highlight>Volatile Notes</color> and ends the <color=Highlight>Resolving Chord</color> state.

<size=10></size>

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.

{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after casting this skill to cast <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Stringblade Stage 4</color>.
<size=10></size>

<size=40><color=Title><color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color></color></size>
After Resonators in the team deal damage to a target, inflict <color=Highlight><te href=141304>Mindlock</te></color> equal to Qingxiao's <color=Highlight>Gathered Mind</color> stacks. This effect can only trigger <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=1} on the same target.

Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Severing Note: Judgement</color> grants <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=141301>Qin Heart</te></color> and removes <color=Highlight>Resonant Chime</color>.

skills.name: Formless Heart Sword
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Ephemeral Transcendence</color></size>
While Qingxiao is in the <color=Highlight>Ephemeral Transcendence</color> state, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence</color> and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence</color> become available.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} repeatedly or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Before <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color> becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by {0}.
Can be cast in mid-air.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence</color></size>
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Before <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color> becomes available, this skill's DMG Multiplier is increased by {0}.
Can be cast in mid-air.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color></size>
When <color=Highlight><te href=141307>Heart Sword Intent</te></color> is full, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color> becomes available. Hold <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> to cast the skill, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>.
Casting this skill consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=141307>Heart Sword Intent</te></color> and ends the <color=Highlight><te href=141303>Ephemeral Transcendence</te></color> state.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mindlock</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Mindlock</color> stacks up to {1} times.
Each time a Resonator in the team inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=100005>Tune Strain - Interfered</te></color> on a target, inflict <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <color=Highlight>Mindlock</color> on the target.

<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heaven's Clarity</color></size>

Switching to another Resonator ends the <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color> enhancement.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color> removes <color=Highlight>Heaven's Clarity</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Swordlight Ward</color></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Tonality Shift</color> or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Stringblade</color> grants <SapTag=8>{8}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=8} of <color=Highlight>Swordlight Ward</color>.
<color=Highlight>Swordlight Ward</color> stacks up to <SapTag=9>{9}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=time P=times SapTag=9}. When taking DMG from an enemy's attack, <SapTag=A>{10}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=A} of <color=Highlight>Swordlight Ward</color> can be consumed to grant immunity to interruption and reduce DMG taken by {11} for {12}s. This effect can be triggered once per second.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sword Flight</color></size>
While in the <color=Highlight>Sword Flight</color> state, Qingxiao moves with a special animation.
Moving in <color=Highlight>Sword Flight</color> continuously consumes <color=Highlight>Flight Qi</color>.
- Casting the following skills sends Qingxiao into the <color=Highlight>Sword Flight</color> state:
<color=Highlight>Sword Glide</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Stringblade</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 1</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 2</color>, <color=Highlight>Severing Note: Ascendant</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence</color>, <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Heaven's Reckoning: Ephemeral Transcendence</color>, and <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Tonality Shift</color>.
- Exit the <color=Highlight>Sword Flight</color> state by:
1. Casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Stringblade Stage 3</color> or <color=Highlight>Plunging Attack</color>.
2. Triggering certain environmental interactions or Utilities.
3. Returning to the ground.
4. Switching to another Resonator.
5. Depleting all <color=Highlight>Flight Qi</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sword Step</color></size>
While in the <color=Highlight><te href=141306>Sword Flight</te></color> state, hold <color=Highlight>Jump</color> to leap up and dash forward a short distance.
<color=Highlight>Sword Step</color> can only be cast once during <color=Highlight><te href=141306>Sword Flight</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Qin Heart</color></size>
Can hold up to {13} points.
Dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Sheathed Stance</color> skills grants <color=Highlight>Qin Heart</color>.
<color=Highlight>Qin Heart</color> cannot be gained while in the <color=Highlight>Ephemeral Transcendence</color> state.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sword Cadence</color></size>
Can hold up to {14} points.
Dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Drawn Stance</color> skills grants <color=Highlight>Sword Cadence</color>.
<color=Highlight>Sword Cadence</color> cannot be gained while in the <color=Highlight>Ephemeral Transcendence</color> state.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heart Sword Intent</color></size>
Can hold up to {15} points.
Dealing damage with <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Ephemeral Transcendence</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Ephemeral Transcendence</color> grants <color=Highlight>Heart Sword Intent</color>.

- The first <SapTag=5>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=5}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Spectro</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>.

- The last <SapTag=B>{12}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stage P=stages SapTag=B}: <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack</color>, dealing <color=Wind>Aero DMG</color>. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> shortly after landing to cast <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Silencing Blade</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> in mid-air to cast <color=Highlight>Thrum of All Sounds: Aero Plunging Attack</color>.

When a target has 1 to 3 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> Amplifies the DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling by {0}, up to {1}.
<size=10></size>
When a target has 4 to 6 stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, each stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> Amplifies the DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling by {2}, up to {3}.

skills.name: One Life, One Blade
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Hush of a Thousand Voices</color> raises the <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> stacks on the targets to the maximum on hit.
<size=10></size>
When nearby Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Windbound</color>. <color=Highlight>Windbound</color> can be gained once every 1s, stacking up to {0} times.
<size=10></size>
When <color=Highlight>Windbound</color> reaches {1} stacks, Yangyang: Xuanling removes all <color=Highlight>Windbound</color> and gains <color=Highlight>One with the Wind</color>.
While <color=Highlight>One with the Wind</color> lasts, when Yangyang: Xuanling casts <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>, she summons <color=Highlight>Feather Release: Xuanling</color> to attack the target, applying <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> to the target. 
<color=Highlight>Windbound</color> cannot be obtained while <color=Highlight>One with the Wind</color> lasts.
<size=10></size>
Once <color=Highlight>Feather Release: Xuanling</color> is summoned, the <color=Highlight>One with the Wind</color> state is removed.

skills.name: Skybound Feather
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Deal <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and restore <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>.
When <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Skybound Feather</color> deals damage, it applies 1 stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on the target.

skills.name: The Way of Ten Thousand Voices
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color></size>
Yangyang: Xuanling is in <color=Highlight>Azure Sword Stance</color> by default. When <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> is depleted while in <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to switch to  <color=Highlight>Azure Sword Stance</color> and cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and restoring <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> and <SapTag=1>{1}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=1} of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>. This instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
When <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> hits the target, consume <SapTag=2>{2}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=2} of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on the target.
The <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> cycle is not reset within a short time after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>. If casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> resets the cycle, summon a <color=Highlight>Wraith of Sound</color> to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes <SapTag=3>{3}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=3} of <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color></size>
When <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> is depleted while in <color=Highlight>Azure Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Feather's Edge</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to switch to <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color> and cast <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> and restoring <SapTag=4>{4}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=4} of <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> and <SapTag=5>{5}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=5} of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>. This instance of DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
When <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> hits, consume <SapTag=6>{6}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on the target.
The <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> cycle is not reset within a short time after casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>. If casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> resets the cycle, summon a <color=Highlight>Wraith of Sound</color> to finish the current attack and deal a fixed instance of <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Basic Attack DMG</color>, which is not affected by any DMG Bonus effects and does not inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>.
Successful Dodge can be triggered within a short time into the action of this skill, which consumes <SapTag=7>{7}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=7} of <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color></size>
When <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color> is restored to its maximum while in <color=Highlight>Azure Sword Stance</color>, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, generating a massive cyclone that strikes the area in front, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, gain <color=Highlight><te href=161003>Bated Breath</te></color>: If Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the field, the Crit. DMG of this <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> increases by {9}. When <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> ends, <color=Highlight><te href=161003>Bated Breath</te></color> is removed. <color=Highlight><te href=161003>Bated Breath</te></color> can be gained up to once every {10}s.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> applies {11} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> to the targets hit.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color></size>
When <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color> is restored to its maximum while in <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color>, if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the ground and not in a <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color> cycle, hold Normal Attack to consume STA and cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>. After it hits a target, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color> is automatically cast.
When casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color>, gain <color=Highlight><te href=161004>Streaming Storm</te></color>, which lasts {12}s. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, the Crit. DMG of this <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> or the next <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color>, or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom</color> is increased by {13}. <color=Highlight><te href=161004>Streaming Storm</te></color> is removed when <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color> Stage 3 or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom</color> Stage 3 ends. <color=Highlight><te href=161004>Streaming Storm</te></color> can be gained up to once every {14}s.
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> applies <SapTag=A>{15}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=A} stacks of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> to the targets hit.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color></size>
When <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color> is restored to its maximum while in <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color> and airborne,  <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color>.
{Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} or hold Normal Attack to consume STA and all <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color> to cast <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color>, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. Casting <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color> enters <color=Highlight>Hark the Wind</color> for {16}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Hark the Wind</color></size>
While in <color=Highlight>Feather Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> is replaced by <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color>, which performs up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color>, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color> Stage 2 and Stage 3 can be cast in mid-air close to the ground. Casting Stage 3 ends <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color>. This attack cycle cannot be reset.
During <color=Highlight>Hark the Wind</color>, a Dodge Counter counts towards the <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color> cycle.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Feathered Oath</color></size>
When nearby Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on a target, Yangyang: Xuanling gains 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Feathered Oath</color> for {17}s. <color=Highlight>Feathered Oath</color> can be gained once every {18}s, stacking up to {19} times. While Yangyang: Xuanling is the active Resonator in the team, each stack increases the Crit. DMG of <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom</color> by {20}, up to {21}.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Refrain</color></size>
Before Yangyang: Xuanling's <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, or <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> hits a target, record and propagate the highest stack count of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on targets within a certain range to all targets within range.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Melody</color></size>
<color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> has a maximum of {22} points.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> restores {23} points of <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color>.
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Hush of a Thousand Voices</color> consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color>.
<color=Highlight>Normal Attacks</color> consumes <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color> upon dealing damage.
Successful Dodge can be triggered during the action of <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> within a certain time of casting these skills, which consumes <SapTag=B>{24}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=B} of <color=Highlight><te href=161001>Melody</te></color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Azure Plume</color></size>
<color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color> has a maximum of {25} points.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>,  <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>, or <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Skybound Feather</color> restores <SapTag=C>{26}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=C} of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Hush of a Thousand Voices</color> restores <SapTag=D>{27}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=point P=points SapTag=D} of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> or <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color> consumes all <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>.

skills.name: Skillful Cooking
skills.descriptionTemplate: Has a chance to produce special dishes when cooking.

skills.name: As the Wind Wills
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Attacks the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> equal to {0} of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK.
All Resonators in the team other than Yangyang: Xuanling gains <color=Highlight>Tonal Switch</color> for {1}s. After a Resonator with <color=Highlight>Tonal Switch</color> inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, that Resonator's Havoc DMG is Amplified by {2}.
This effect is reset upon casting this skill again.

skills.name: Tune Break - Sword
skills.descriptionTemplate: When the target's <color=Highlight>Off-Tune Level</color> is full, the Resonator may cast <color=Highlight><te href=100001>Tune Break</te></color> on the target.

chains.name: At the Wind's Breath, the Blossoms Wake
chains.descriptionTemplate:
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> summons a <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Unfaltering</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> equal to {0} of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK. This DMG is considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>.
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> Stagnates nearby enemies.
<size=10></size>
<color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color> and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom</color> are immune to interruption.

chains.name: River Carries Her Song Away
chains.descriptionTemplate:
The DMG dealt by <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color>, <color=Highlight>Mid-air Attack - Feather Fall</color>,  <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Havoc in Bloom</color>, and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter - Havoc in Bloom</color> is increased by {0}.
<size=10></size>
Every time Yangyang: Xuanling remains out of combat for more than 4s after she leaves the combat state or revives, she gains the following effects once:
- Gain <color=Highlight>Strung Notes</color>, up to 1 stack. Casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color> or <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> summons <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Strung Notes</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> equal to {1} of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK, considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color>. <color=Highlight>Strung Notes</color> is removed after <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Strung Notes</color> is summoned.
- Restore 2 points of <color=Highlight><te href=161002>Azure Plume</te></color>.
- Reset the Cooldown of gaining <color=Highlight><te href=161003>Bated Breath</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=161004>Streaming Storm</te></color>.

chains.name: My Grief Follows You into the Clouds
chains.descriptionTemplate:
The DMG dealt via Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Hush of a Thousand Voices</color> is Amplified by {0}.
<size=10></size>
After casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Skybound Feather</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>, increase the maximum <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> stacks on targets within a certain range by {1}, lasting {2}s. This effect does not stack.
<size=10></size>
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Azure Sword Stance Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack - Feather Sword Stance Stage 4</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Azure Sword Stance</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack - Feather Sword Stance</color> inflict 1 additional stack of <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on the target.

chains.name: Across the Miles, a Letter and My Longing
chains.descriptionTemplate: When casting <color=Highlight>Intro Skill - Skybound Feather</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Azure</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Switch: Feather</color>, <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color>, or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color>, the ATK of Resonators in the team is increased by {0} for {1}s.

chains.name: Take Wing. Take Wing.
chains.descriptionTemplate: When Yangyang: Xuanling takes a fatal blow, she will not be downed, but instead recover HP equal to {0} of her Max HP while becoming immune to DMG and interruption for {1}s. This effect can be triggered once every {2} min.

chains.name: Let the Azure Keep Its Light
chains.descriptionTemplate:
After Yangyang: Xuanling inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> on a target, gain <color=Highlight>Voice Flux</color> for {0}s. While <color=Highlight>Voice Flux</color> is active, targets take {1} more Heavy Attack DMG from Yangyang: Xuanling.
<size=10></size>
Casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Azure</color> or <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill - Sword Stance Flow: Feather</color> grants <color=Highlight>Still as Withered Wood</color> for {2}s. While <color=Highlight>Still as Withered Wood</color> is active, if Yangyang: Xuanling is on the field, then after nearby Resonators in the team inflict <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color>, or <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color>, Yangyang: Xuanling summons <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Dark>Havoc DMG</color> equal to {3} of Yangyang: Xuanling's ATK. The DMG of <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood</color> is considered <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack DMG</color> and is guaranteed to be a critical hit.
<size=10></size>
<color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood</color> can be summoned once every {4}s, and <color=Highlight>Still as Withered Wood</color> expires after it is summoned {5} times. When <color=Highlight>Still as Withered Wood</color> expires or is removed, reset the available summon charges of <color=Highlight>Shadow of Xuanling: Still as Withered Wood</color>. <color=Highlight>Still as Withered Wood</color> has a Cooldown of {6}s.

skills.name: Zapstring's Dance
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Yinlin controls the puppet "Zapstring" to perform up to 4 attacks, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>
Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring", dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Yinlin consumes STA to control "Zapstring" to perform a Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

skills.name: Magnetic Roar
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Magnetic Roar</color></size>
The puppet "Zapstring" deals <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> to the target, and puts Yinlin in Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Execution Mode</color>.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Execution Mode</color></size>
<color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> and <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> will trigger 1 <color=Highlight>Electromagnetic Blast</color> when hitting a target.
Each stage of <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> or <color=Highlight>Dodge Counter</color> can only trigger 1 <color=Highlight>Electromagnetic Blast</color>, up to 4 times.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Electromagnetic Blast</color></size>
Attack all targets marked with Forte Circuit <color=Highlight><te href=850029>Sinner's Mark</te></color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Lightning Execution</color></size>
Use Resonance Skill after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Magnetic Roar</color> to cast <color=Highlight>Lightning Execution</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.
If Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lightning Execution</color> is not activated in a while or this Character is switched, this Skill will be put on Cooldown.

skills.name: Thundering Wrath
skills.descriptionTemplate: Command "Zapstring" to call for thunder to fall upon a large range, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>.

skills.name: Pain Immersion
skills.descriptionTemplate: After using Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Magnetic Roar</color>, Yinlin's Crit. Rate is increased by {0} for {1}s.

skills.name: Deadly Focus
skills.descriptionTemplate: The damage of Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Lightning Execution</color> is increased by {0} when hitting targets marked with <color=Highlight><te href=850029>Sinner's Mark</te></color>, and Yinlin's ATK is increased by {1} for {2}s when this is triggered.

skills.name: Raging Storm
skills.descriptionTemplate: Command puppet "Zapstring" to attack, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color> in a large range.

skills.name: Chameleon Cipher
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Chameleon Cipher</color></size>
When Yinlin's Judgment Points are full, her <color=Highlight>Heavy Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Chameleon Cipher</color>, which consumes all Judgment Points to attack the target, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. When it hits a target marked with <color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color>, the <color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Punishment Mark</color>, lasting for {0}s. <color=Highlight>Chameleon Cipher</color> deals Heavy Attack DMG.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Sinner's Mark</color></size>
Basic Attack <color=Highlight>Zapstring's Dance</color>, Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Thundering Wrath</color>, and Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Roaring Storm</color> apply <color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color> to the target on hit.
<color=Highlight>Sinner's Mark</color> is removed when Yinlin is switched out.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Punishment Mark</color></size>
When a target marked with <color=Highlight>Punishment Mark</color> takes damage, <color=Highlight>Judgement Strike</color> will fall, triggering Coordinated Attacks to all targets marked with <color=Highlight>Punishment Mark</color>, dealing <color=Thunder>Electro DMG</color>. This can be triggered up to 1 time per second. <color=Highlight>Judgement Strike</color> deals Resonance Skill DMG.
<size=10> </size>
<size=40><color=Title>Judgment Points</color></size>
Yinlin can hold up to {1} Judgement Points. Yinlin gains Judgement Points through the following ways:

skills.name: Restless Watch
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Standard Defense Protocol</color></size>
Attack the target to deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and enter a block stance. This state ends early if Zani is switched off the field. {Cus:Ipt,Touch=Tap PC=Press Gamepad=Press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to perform <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>, recovering 10 points of <te href=850063>Redundant Energy</te> and Stagnating the target on hit.
When attacked by an enemy while in block stance, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then cast <color=Highlight>Pinpoint Strike</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> and further reducing their <te href=850062>Vibration Strength</te> by  {0}. DMG taken by Zani is reduced by {3} within the next {2}s.

<size=40><color=Title>Crisis Response Protocol</color></size>
When Zani is not in <color=Highlight><te href=850064>Inferno Mode</te></color> and has full <te href=850063>Redundant Energy</te>, her <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Crisis Response Protocol</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>. While in <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early if Zani is switched off the field. After releasing <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button or when the stance duration ends, consume all Redundant Energy to cast <color=Highlight>Targeted Action</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color>, which is also considered <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle DMG</color>.
When attacked by an enemy in while in <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and consume all Redundant Energy to cast <color=Highlight>Forcible Riposte</color>, dealing <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> (also considered <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle DMG</color>), Stagnating the target, and further reducing their <te href=850062>Vibration Strength</te> by {1}. DMG taken by Zani is reduced by {3} within the next {2}s.
Casting <color=Highlight>Targeted Action</color> or <color=Highlight>Forcible Riposte</color> sends Zani into <color=Highlight>Sunburst</color> mode and inflicts a stack of <te href=850066>Heliacal Ember</te> upon the target on hit. The last stage of the attack recovers <te href=850065>Blaze</te>.

<size=40><color=Title>Sunburst</color></size>

<size=40><color=Title>The Last Stand</color></size>

skills.name: There Will Be A Light
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Heliacal Ember</color></size>
When Zani is in the team and a nearby Resonator inflicts <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> upon a target, immediately trigger the DMG of all Spectro Frazzle stacks and convert Spectro Frazzle into an equal number of Heliacal Embers. Every time the conversion happens, Zani obtains Blaze based on the stacks of Heliacal Ember inflicted. Heliacal Ember is capped at {0} stacks, with each stack lasting for {1}s. Heliacal Ember stacks are counted toward the Spectro Frazzle stacks for the Eternal Radiance Sonata Effect.

<size=40><color=Title>Scorching Light</color></size>
When Zani is in <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color>, <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>, and <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color> become available, which deal <color=Light>Spectro DMG</color> that is considered both Heavy Attack DMG and <color=Highlight>Spectro Frazzle</color> DMG.
When Blaze is no less than {2}, Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Standard Defense Protocol</color> is replaced with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Light</color>.
Hold <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, during which Zani is immune to interruption. This state ends early when Zani is switched off the field. While in <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, release <color=Highlight>Resonance Skill</color> button within a certain time to consume Blaze and perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>.
When attacked in a certain time after entering <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>, reduce this instance of damage by 100% and Stagnate nearby targets, then perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color>, consuming Blazes and further reducing their <te href=850062>Vibration Strength</te> by {3}. Zani's DMG taken within the next {4}s is reduced by {5}.
After casting <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>, consuming up to {6} Blazes on hit, with each Blaze increasing the DMG Multiplier of <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>. If <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 1</color> is interrupted, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> again to cast <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall Stage 2</color>.
Upon releasing the button after a certain time or when <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color> ends, immediately perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>.
When Blaze is no less than {2}, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>. After entering <color=Highlight>Inferno Mode</color>, casting <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> immediately replaces the current <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> with Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Scorching Light</color>. Hold <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> to enter <color=Highlight>Ready Stance</color>.
After performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Daybreak</color>, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> immediately to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color> at the cost of Blaze.
After performing <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Dawning</color>, <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color>.
If <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> is not replaced with <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Nightfall</color> after a successful Dodge and Zani has no less than {2} Blazes, {Cus:Ipt,Touch=tap PC=press Gamepad=press} <color=Highlight>Normal Attack</color> within a certain time to perform <color=Highlight>Heavy Slash - Lightsmash</color> at the cost of Blazes.

<size=40><color=Title>Redundant Energy</color></size>
Zani can hold up to 100 Redundant Energy.
Obtain Redundant Energy when Normal Attacks hit a target.
Obtain Redundant Energy when casting Intro Skill <color=Highlight>Immediate Execution</color>.

Casting <color=Highlight>Targeted Action</color> or <color=Highlight>Forcible Riposte</color> grants 10 Blazes.
Every stack of Heliacal Ember converted from <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color> grants 5 Blazes.
Casting Resonance Liberation <color=Highlight>Rekindle</color> grants 50 Blazes.

Gain following effects when in <color=Highlight><te href=850064>Inferno Mode</te></color>:

skills.name: Dimming Brush
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Basic Attack</color></size>
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform an attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
Heavy Attack does not reset the Basic Attack cycle.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Mid-air Attack</color></size>
Consume STA to perform up to 2 consecutive attacks while in mid-air, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Dodge Counter</color></size>
Use <color=Highlight>Basic Attack</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.

skills.name: Manifestation
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Deal <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>. If <te href=850028>Afflatus</te> is no less than 60, consume 60 Afflatus to summon <color=Highlight><te href=850026>Phatasmic Imprint</te> - Left</color> and <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Right</color>.
-Press the button on the ground to summon the Phantasmic Imprints on the ground.
-Hold the button on the ground or press the button in mid-air to summon the Phantasmic Imprints in mid-air.

skills.name: Living Canvas
skills.descriptionTemplate:
Summon <color=Highlight>Inklit Spirits</color> for assistance.
Can be cast in mid-air.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Inklit Spirit</color></size>
When the active Resonator deals DMG, an <color=Highlight>Inklit Spirit</color> will be summoned to perform a Coordinated Attack, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG.
-For {0}s after dealing DMG, 1 <color=Highlight>Inklit Spirit</color> is summoned per second. This effect can trigger once per second. Damage dealt by an Inklit Spirit does not trigger this effect.
-Up to {1} <color=Highlight>Inklit Spirit</color> can be summoned every second, and up to {2} in total.
-This effect lasts for {3}s, or until max <color=Highlight>Inklit Spirits</color> are summoned.

skills.descriptionTemplate: When casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Creation's Zenith</color>, ATK is increased by {0} for {2}s. This can be stacked up to {1} time(s).

skills.name: Ink and Wash
skills.descriptionTemplate:
<size=40><color=Title>Phantasmic Imprint</color></size>
Zhezhi may summon <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprints</color> at the cost of Afflatus when casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Manifestation</color> or Heavy Attack <color=Highlight>Conjuration</color>.
Up to 1 of each of <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Left</color>, <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Middle</color>, and <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Right</color> can exist at the same time, each lasting for {0}s.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Heavy Attack - Conjuration</color></size>
The 5 moves below consume STA to perform <color=Highlight>Conjuration</color> to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>.
-Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> shortly after <color=Highlight>Basic Attack Stage 3</color>.
-Press the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> shortly after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Manifestation</color>.
-Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> shortly after casting Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color> or Resonance Skill <color=Highlight>Creation's Zenith</color>.
-Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> while in mid-air.
-Hold the <color=Highlight>Normal Attack button</color> after a successful <color=Highlight>Dodge</color>.
If Zhezhi has at least 30 Afflatus when performing any of these, consume 30 Afflatus to summon a <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint - Middle</color>.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Stroke of Genius</color></size>
When a <color=Highlight>Phatasmic Imprint</color> is nearby, the Resonance Skill is replaced with <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color>, which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:
-Move to the location of the <color=Highlight>Phatasmic Imprint</color>, remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target <color=Highlight>Phatasmic Imprint</color> is in mid-air.
-Gain 1 stack of Painter's Delight, lasting for {1}s and stacking up to 2 times.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Resonance Skill - Creation's Zenith</color></size>
When a <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint</color> is nearby and there are 2 stacks of Painter's Delight, <color=Highlight>Stroke of Genius</color> is replaced with <color=Highlight>Creation's Zenith</color>, which can be cast while in mid-air. When it is cast, Zhezhi will:
-Lose all stacks of Painter's Delight
-Move to the location of the <color=Highlight>Phantasmic Imprint</color>, remove it, and then summon an Ivory Herald to attack the target, dealing greater <color=Ice>Glacio DMG</color>, considered as Basic Attack DMG, additionally increasing the Basic Attack DMG Bonus by {2} for {3}s. Refresh the mid-air Dodge attempts if the target <color=Highlight>Phatasmic Imprint</color> is in mid-air.
<size=10></size>
<size=40><color=Title>Afflatus</color></size>
Zhezhi can hold up to 90 Afflatus.
Normal Attacks grant Afflatus on hit.
Casting Intro Skill grants Afflatus.
